### [1] [A Cone-Constrained Bilinear Decomposition for Total Scaled-Gradient Variation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00036)
*Haibin Su,Chunlin Wu,Huibin Chang,Zhifang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对TSGV正则化器因高度非凸非线性而带来的计算难题，提出了一种定制的双线性分解方法，将非线性加权梯度解耦，从而将原问题转化为受锥或球约束的等价优化问题。采用配备MM策略的交替最小化方法求解，无需步长调节即可保证能量单调递减，并在KL框架下建立全局收敛性。数值实验表明该方法在图像去噪和NLOS成像中性能优于或媲美代表性变分方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TSGV正则化器虽然在图像恢复中能有效保留边缘和角点，但其高度非凸非线性的特性导致现有方法要么对参数敏感，要么缺乏收敛性保证，严重制约了其实际应用。

Method: 提出定制的双线性分解以解耦TSGV正则化器中的非线性加权梯度，将问题转化为由锥或球约束（取决于缩放函数选择）刻画的等价优化问题。采用配备MM策略的交替最小化方法求解，并利用KL框架分析全局收敛性，同时通过几何分析解释约束在图像奇异性附近的渐近行为来揭示边缘保持特性。

Result: 在Gaussian去噪和NLOS成像的大量数值实验中，所提方法在PSNR和SSIM上达到与代表性变分方法相当或更优的性能，尤其在噪声水平高的场景下效果突出，并在密集和稀疏扫描下改善了结构重建质量。

Conclusion: 通过双线性分解和MM策略的交替最小化，成功解决了TSGV正则化器的计算挑战，在保证收敛性的同时实现了优越的图像恢复性能，为高非凸非线性能量函数的高效求解提供了新的方法论路径。

Abstract: The total scaled-gradient variation (TSGV) regularizer, derived from sparse modeling of piecewise-linear structures, has been shown to preserve edges and corners in image restoration. However, its highly nonconvex and nonlinear nature poses severe computational challenges, as existing methods often suffer from parameter sensitivity or lack convergence guarantees. To overcome this, we propose a tailored bilinear decomposition that decouples the nonlinear weighted gradient in the TSGV regularizer. This approach yields an equivalent optimization problem governed by cone or sphere constraints, depending on the chosen scaling function. In particular, the cone constraint plays a central role in characterizing edge- and corner-preserving behavior. We solve this reformulation using the alternating minimization method (AMM) equipped with a majorization--minimization strategy, ensuring a monotonic decrease in energy without step-size tuning. Furthermore, we provide a geometric interpretation of the edge-preserving properties of these constraints by analyzing their asymptotic behavior near image singularities. We establish the global convergence of the proposed method to a critical point within the Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz framework. Extensive numerical experiments on Gaussian denoising and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging show that the proposed method achieves PSNR and SSIM competitive with or superior to representative variational methods, especially at high noise levels, and improves the structural reconstruction under dense and sparse scanning.

</details>


### [2] [Qwen-Drive-1.0: An Initial Step towards a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00111)
*Xin Zhou,Zongchuang Zhao,Zhibo Yang,Mingsheng Li,Humen Zhong,Shuai Bai,Du Chu,Ruizhe Chen,Zhaohai Li,Jun Tang,Qiuyue Wang,Mingkun Yang,Jiazhao Zhang,Dayiheng Liu,Dingkang Liang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了Qwen-Drive-1.0，一个面向自动驾驶的视觉语言基础模型，在统一框架中整合了3D感知、视觉问答与运动规划，并通过分阶段训练策略在保持通用视觉语言能力的同时实现强大的驾驶性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶需要同时具备3D场景理解与高层语义推理能力，但现有的视觉语言模型（VLM）主要面向通用视觉理解，缺乏对驾驶场景的3D感知与运动规划支持。需要一个既能保留通用VLM能力，又能融入驾驶专用技能的联合框架。

Method: 1) 保留预训练VLM架构，集成3D感知、视觉问答与运动规划；2) 引入外部鸟瞰图(BEV)感知头，联合执行3D物体检测、语义占用预测与BEV地图分割，作为共享表征中3D信息的探针并显式可检查地暴露场景3D结构；3) 构建Planning Expert模块，基于共享VLM表征生成未来自我车辆轨迹；4) 采用分阶段训练策略，结合驾驶监督信号与通用视觉语言数据。

Result: 实验表明：在3D感知与驾驶场景理解上表现优异，同时基本保持了通用视觉语言能力；在开放环路、伪闭环和闭环设置下的综合评估均展现出具有高度竞争力的运动规划性能。

Conclusion: Qwen-Drive-1.0验证了在单一视觉语言基础模型框架内统一3D感知、VQA与运动规划的可行性，为自动驾驶领域的基础模型发展迈出了重要一步。

Abstract: We present Qwen-Drive-1.0, an initial step towards a vision-language foundation model for autonomous driving. Qwen-Drive-1.0 retains the architecture of the pretrained vision-language model (VLM) and integrates 3D perception, visual question answering, and motion planning within a unified framework. An external bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception head jointly performs 3D object detection, semantic occupancy prediction, and BEV map segmentation. It serves as a probe of the 3D information accessible from the shared representations and provides an explicit, inspectable interface to 3D scene structure. A Planning Expert conditions on shared VLM representations to generate future ego trajectories. A staged training recipe combines driving supervision with general-purpose vision-language data to acquire driving-specific competence while helping preserve broad visual understanding and instruction-following capabilities. Experiments demonstrate strong 3D perception and driving scene understanding while largely preserving general vision-language capability. Comprehensive evaluations across open-loop, pseudo-closed-loop, and closed-loop settings further show highly competitive motion-planning performance.

</details>


### [3] [ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00188)
*Xionghao Wu,Yijun Yang,Shiyang Zhou,Haoze Sun,Jianhui Liu,Songsong Yu,Jiyao Zhang,Wenbo Li,Bo Wang,Guoqing Ma,Lin Song,Renjie Liao,Shenghe Zheng,Wei Tang,Xiaojuan Qi,Yanwei Li,Yuan Zhang,Zhuotao Tian,Haoyang Huang,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZimaBlue是一个可扩展的框架，用于从大规模第一视角视频中学习通用的世界动作模型（WAMs）。通过三阶段训练课程（因果具身视频预训练→视频-动作中间训练→目标机器人微调部署），结合异步慢-快双系统架构，实现了30Hz的实时动作预测。在真实机器人零样本评估中，将训练数据从仅目标机器人扩展到超过12万小时的具身视频，成功率从36.1%提升至77.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作面临根本性的扩展挑战：鲁棒泛化需要广泛的身体经验，但带动作标签的机器人轨迹收集成本高昂且多样性固有受限。第一视角视频提供了更可扩展的具身经验来源，但如何将这些丰富的无动作经验转化为有效的机器人控制是核心难题。

Method: ZimaBlue采用三阶段训练课程：(1) 在大规模人类和机器人第一视角视频上进行因果具身视频预训练；(2) 通过统一动作表示，在异构机器人轨迹上进行视频-动作中间训练，将学习的视觉动力学落地到机器人动作空间；(3) 针对目标机器人进行微调部署。此外采用异步慢-快双系统架构，高容量的慢速世界模型提供泛化的时空表征，轻量快速分支在RTX 4090上实现30Hz动作预测。

Result: 在真实机器人零样本评估中，从仅使用目标机器人数据扩展到超120,000小时具身视频，成功率从36.1%提升至77.8%。在多个基准测试上表现强劲，尤其在未见任务上增益显著。

Conclusion: 通过将大规模无动作视频作为可扩展的具身经验来源，结合渐进式的训练课程和高效的双系统架构，ZimaBlue验证了利用大规模视频学习通用机器人世界动作模型的可行性与有效性，为解决机器人操作的规模化泛化挑战提供了新路径。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation faces a fundamental scaling challenge: robust generalization demands broad physical experience, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are expensive to collect and inherently limited in diversity. Egocentric videos offer a far more scalable source of embodied experience, capturing object interactions, contact dynamics, tool use, and long-horizon behaviors across diverse environments. The central challenge is how to convert this abundant but action-free experience into effective robot control. We introduce ZimaBlue, a scalable framework for learning generalizable World Action Models (WAMs) from large-scale video. ZimaBlue follows a three-stage training curriculum: it first performs causal embodied video pre-training on large-scale human and robot egocentric videos, then grounds the learned visual dynamics in heterogeneous robot trajectories through video-action mid-training with a unified action representation, and finally specializes the model to a target robot for deployment. To make generative WAMs practical for real-time control, ZimaBluefurther adopts an asynchronous Slow-Fast dual-system architecture, where a high-capacity Slow world model provides generalizable spatiotemporal representations and a lightweight Fast branch enables 30 Hz action prediction on NVIDIA RTX 4090. On real-robot zero-shot evaluations, scaling from target-robot data alone to over 120,000 hours of embodied video improves success from 36.1% to 77.8%. ZimaBlue further delivers strong performance across multiple benchmarks, with particularly pronounced gains on unseen tasks.

</details>


### [4] [A Lagrangian View of Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00198)
*Peyman Milanfar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出从拉格朗日（粒子中心）视角自下而上地推导显式时间生成模型（如Flow Matching和Rectified Flow），取代传统自上而下的欧拉（宏观质量输运）方法。通过分析连续去噪器的局部泰勒展开，推导出最优单步生成所需的"目标身份守恒"不变性条件，进而得到拟线性平流偏微分方程（PDE）。利用特征线法求解该PDE，可解析地得到Flow Matching的直线轨迹，并揭示了去噪器雅可比矩阵是轨迹曲率的主要来源，为直线流形为何支持大步长提供了直接数学解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有显式时间生成模型（Flow Matching、Rectified Flow）通常通过最优传输和连续性方程自上而下推导（欧拉视角），这种宏观方法关注概率质量的输运，但缺乏对粒子级动力学行为的微观理解。作者希望从底层力学（拉格朗日视角）出发，提供一种替代性推导路径，以更深刻地解释直线轨迹的内在原因及其对大步长生成的支持。

Method: 作者从连续去噪器的局部泰勒展开出发，提出"目标身份守恒"这一严格不变性条件作为最优单步生成的必要条件。通过强制该条件，推导出拟线性平流PDE。随后利用特征线法（Method of Characteristics）解析求解该PDE，证明其解正是Flow Matching的直线轨迹。该几何视角将去噪器的雅可比矩阵识别为轨迹曲率的主要来源。

Result: 该研究在数学上证明：（1）通过特征线法求解所提出的PDE可以得到与Flow Matching一致的直线轨迹；（2）去噪器的雅可比矩阵是导致轨迹弯曲的主要因素；（3）直线流形之所以能支持巨大步长，正是因为其消除了轨迹曲率；（4）经验模型需要蒸馏来"拉直"由于特征线相交而产生的弯曲轨迹。

Conclusion: 本文提供的拉格朗日力学推导框架为生成模型提供了全新的理论视角，将去噪器的雅可比矩阵确立为轨迹曲率的根本来源，从而在数学上解释了直线流形在大步长生成中的优越性以及蒸馏的必要性——即消除特征线相交导致的曲率积累。

Abstract: Modern explicit-time generative models, such as Flow Matching [Lipman et al., 2023] and Rectified Flow [Liu et al., 2023], are typically derived top-down via Optimal Transport and the continuity equation. This standard Eulerian approach focuses on the macroscopic transport of probability mass. In this paper, we present an alternative, bottom-up mechanical derivation grounded in a Lagrangian (particle-centric) perspective. By analyzing the local Taylor expansion of a continuous denoiser, we motivate a strict invariance condition required for optimal, singlestep generation: the conservation of target identity. Enforcing this condition yields a governing quasi-linear advection Partial Differential Equation (PDE). We demonstrate that solving this PDE via the Method of Characteristics analytically yields the straight-line trajectories of Flow Matching. This geometric perspective isolates the Jacobian of the denoiser as the primary source of trajectory curvature, providing a direct mathematical explanation for why straight-line flows enable massive step sizes, and why empirical models require distillation to flatten intersecting characteristics.

</details>


### [5] [Distributed Implicit Harm: A Compositional Safety Blind Spot in MLLM-Based Video Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00206)
*Ruotong Wang,Zihao Zhu,Siwei Lyu,Xin Tao,Baoyuan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视频审核中的一个"组合安全盲点"：由看似良性的组件组成的视频，在整体解读时可能传达有害含义，作者称之为"分布式隐式危害"（DIH）。作者通过多智能体合成框架生成了超过9000个带注释的DIH视频，并对30多个MLLMs进行基准测试，发现即使是顶尖的前沿模型也无法识别这类组合性危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全数据集和审核方法基于局部视觉线索、关键词或单模态信号，无法捕获这类组合性危害；真实世界中此类视频难以收集和标注，导致缺乏相关数据来研究这一安全漏洞。

Method: 提出多智能体合成框架，将独立良性的组件组合成有害场景，并生成带显式推理注释的多样化DIH视频；重点研究两种代表性类型：时间维度上跨视觉分段的危害（DIH-T）和跨模态（音视频）危害（DIH-M）。

Result: 构建了超过9000个视频的数据集，涵盖纯视觉和音视频设置；对30多个MLLMs（包括前沿专有模型和领先开源系统）的基准测试显示一致性的检测缺陷；在真实社交媒体DIH视频上的评估也证实了相同失败模式。

Conclusion: DIH是视频审核中一个实际存在且未被充分探索的挑战。即使最强的前沿模型能正确评估单个组件，也无法识别组件组合后涌现的有害含义，指出了MLLMs在组合性安全性上的系统性不足。

Abstract: Despite their growing use in video moderation, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit a compositional safety blind spot: videos composed of seemingly benign components can convey harmful meaning when interpreted as a whole. We refer to this phenomenon as Distributed Implicit Harm (DIH), where harm arises from relations among components distributed along a decomposition axis of the video, rather than from any single explicit cue. Among many possible axes, we study two representative cases: temporally distributed harm across visual segments (DIH-T) and cross-modal harm between audio and visual streams (DIH-M). Studying and mitigating DIH at scale requires data that is difficult to collect: such videos lack compositional harm annotations, evade retrieval based on local visual cues, keywords, or single-modality signals, and are consequently absent from existing safety datasets. To bridge this gap, we develop a multi-agent synthesis framework that composes individually benign components into harmful scenarios and generates diverse DIH videos with explicit reasoning annotations, yielding a dataset of over 9,000 videos spanning visual-only and audio-visual settings. Benchmarking over 30 MLLMs spanning frontier proprietary models and leading open-source systems reveals substantial and consistent deficits in detecting both DIH-T and DIH-M. Notably, this failure persists even among the strongest frontier models: they often correctly assess individual components in isolation but fail to recognize the harmful meaning that emerges from their composition. We further evaluate these models on a manually collected set of real-world DIH videos from social media and observe the same failure mode, highlighting DIH as a practical and underexplored challenge for video moderation.

</details>


### [6] [Beyond Language Priors: Diagnosing and Fixing Visual-Origin Hallucinations in Multimodal LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00231)
*Peiyang Xu,Xiaopei Zhu,Jun Zhu,Xiaolin Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文挑战了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对象幻觉主要由语言先验导致的传统观点，提出视觉来源幻觉这一互补原因——即错误的视觉特征提取和图像-文本嵌入错位。通过余弦相似度分析和Smooth Grad-CAM熵测量提供了定量证据，并提出了对抗对比微调方法（ACFT）来解决该问题，在多个基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将MLLM的对象幻觉问题几乎全部归因于语言先验（如过度依赖文本共现统计），但作者认为这并未涵盖全部原因，存在被忽视的视觉来源幻觉——由视觉特征提取错误和图像-文本模态对齐不良导致。

Method: 1) 诊断阶段：通过余弦相似度分析和Smooth Grad-CAM熵测量提供定量证据，揭示幻觉样本具有更低的图像-文本相似度（0.158 vs -0.122）和反转的注意力模式。2) 提出对抗幻觉属性翻转（AHAF）程序，通过最小化、针对性对抗扰动翻转图像的幻觉属性，构建完全对齐的正负样本对。3) 使用对比微调（ACFT）在正负对上训练，同时AHAF作为诊断探针揭示视觉表示接近幻觉决策边界。

Result: 仅需COCO数据集的0.9%且零推理开销，ACFT在POPE、MME及四个描述级幻觉基准上，跨LLaVA、MiniGPT-4和Qwen2.5-VL等模型均取得最先进性能。

Conclusion: 视觉来源幻觉是MLLM对象幻觉的重要且被低估的原因，ACFT通过对抗对比微调能有效缓解该问题，其高效性和通用性表明该方法具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Existing research on object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) predominantly attributes the problem to language priors such as over-reliance on textual co-occurrence statistics. We challenge this view by presenting quantitative evidence for a complementary, under-explored cause: visual-origin hallucination, where hallucinations arise from incorrect visual feature extraction and misalignment between image and text embeddings. Through cosine similarity analysis and Smooth Grad-CAM entropy measurements, we show that hallucinated samples exhibit systematically lower image-text similarity (average 0.158 vs. -0.122) and inverted attention patterns, where attention is dispersed when the target object is present but wrongly concentrated when it is absent. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose Adversarial Contrastive Fine-Tuning (ACFT). ACFT uses an Adversarial Hallucination Attribute Flipping (AHAF) procedure, involving minimal, targeted adversarial perturbations that flip an image's hallucination attribute, to construct perfectly aligned positive-negative pairs, which are then used for contrastive fine-tuning. AHAF simultaneously serves as a diagnostic probe, revealing that MLLM visual representations lie dangerously close to hallucination decision boundaries. Requiring only 0.9% of the COCO dataset and adding zero inference overhead, ACFT achieves state-of-the-art performance on POPE, MME, and four description-level hallucination benchmarks across LLaVA, MiniGPT-4, and Qwen2.5-VL. Code is available at https://github.com/zxp555/ACFT_MM

</details>


### [7] [Mind the Rift: Cross-Scale Coupling Mismatch for AI-Generated Video Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00742)
*Siyu Li,Jin Yang,Weiheng Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RIFT框架，利用跨尺度耦合失配（宏观时间动态与微观像素残差之间的不一致）作为新型取证信号来检测AI生成视频。在120K和68K视频基准上分别达到99.33%和99.72%的F1分数，具有97.87%的未见生成器检测率、编码器无关性和跨编码器家族的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI视频生成器已达到电影级真实感，可靠的检测对维护数字信任至关重要。现有方法忽视了自然视频中宏观语义动态与微观像素残差由统一成像物理管线产生的内在耦合关系，而AI生成器在训练中未显式保留该联合分布，系统性破坏了这种耦合。作者将此失配作为新颖的取证信号进行检测。

Method: RIFT（轨迹表征不一致取证）由三个互锁组件构成：1) 宏观流：通过微分几何和持久同调在学习到的流形轨迹上构建期望时间演化的动态基线；2) 微观流：通过隐写滤波和时间建模作为灵敏的取证探针；3) 耦合散度模块：测量两流之间的条件依赖关系。Gram-Schmidt正交化保证该测量的信息论有效性。

Result: 在两个基准上（VidProM：120K视频、7个生成器；GenVidBench：68K视频、4个生成器）分别达到99.33%和99.72%的F1分数；留一评估中未见生成器检测率达97.87%。表现出编码器无关性：从ViT-S/14（22M）扩展到ViT-L/14（300M）F1变化小于0.1%，切换至DINOv1编码器家族仅降低0.73个百分点。

Instead, we propose CrossFeat, a framework that enables an existing monomodal descriptor to operate across modalities. Our method learns a crossing function in descriptor space that maps features from one modality to a representation compatible with another. </details>

Abstract: We present FoldingAgent, an agentic framework for inferring explicit parametric folding programs directly from origami demonstration videos. To translate visual content into folding programs, we define a parametric space that consists of the paper's geometry and a set of parametric folding actions. Abstract: Histopathological whole slide images (WSIs) are central to cancer diagnosis, but their gigapixel scale, tissue heterogeneity, weak slide-level supervision, sparse diagnostic regions, and multi-scale evidence make robust automated analysis challenging. Abstract: Modern face recognition (FR) owes much of its success to deep neural networks that learn to extract compact identity embeddings from face images. In contrast, foundation models, pretrained on broad visual or vision--language tasks, provide rich interfaces for describing, retrieving, generating, and organizing visual content. This study applies Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to SAM3 for multi-class structural defect segmentation and examines both how such a model can be supervised from conventional annotation and whether the resulting efficiency gain transfers across datasets. Second, we identify and mitigate a failure mode specific to this setting: because a conventional annotation file yields positive prompts exclusively, the model's presence prediction decouples from the text condition and degenerates into responding to any prompt, a collapse that is invisible to every metric computed on positive prompts alone. Abstract: From horizon detection to fibre structures in X-ray imaging, many vision tasks recover lines via peak detection in Hough space $H=S^1\times\mathbb{R}$, the domain of orientation-offset pairs $(θ,ρ)$. Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used to measure urban change from repeated street-level imagery, but their longitudinal reliability is not well understood. Abstract: Physically Plausible Video Generation (PPVG) seeks to synthesize videos consistent with physical principles, yet remains challenging due to underspecified natural language conditioning. Our framework comprises three key modules: (1) Physics-driven Event Chain Reasoning. This module decomposes physical phenomena into causally connected events represented by evolving scene graphs. Formula-derived physical quantities are bound to relevant objects and interactions, characterizing the direction and magnitude of each event transition. (2) Transition-aware Routed Keyframe Conditioning. This module routes each event to a specialized keyframe synthesis operator for appearance variation or object transformation. Consecutive keyframes are injected as residual guidance during denoising, enabling smooth visual transitions between event-boundary states. (3) Physics-injected Contrastive Semantic Guidance. This module constructs physics-informed positive and counterfactual negative prompts for classifier-free guidance, steering generation toward plausible dynamics and away from physics-violating counterparts. Abstract: Landslides are widespread geological hazards, yet their automated detection and mapping in remote sensing imagery remain challenging because of their irregular morphology, ambiguous spectral signatures, and substantial domain shifts across imaging platforms. We additionally construct a global-scale open-world landslide benchmark by systematically harmonizing multiple publicly available remote sensing data collected by diverse institutions. Abstract: Estimation of the absolute pose of an object is an essential task for various robotic applications. Recently, incorporating gravity direction as prior information has emerged as a popular approach to simplify absolute pose estimation. In this paper, we propose a novel transformation strategy that exploits geometric relations derived from the gravity prior. Through transformation decoupling, the original 6 degrees of freedom (DoF) absolute pose estimation problem is simplified into a 4-DoFs problem: 1-DoF for the rotation angle and 3-DoFs for translation, significantly improving the efficiency. For the 1-DoF rotation angle, we apply a one-dimensional global voting algorithm for optimal estimation. Once the optimal rotation is obtained, the mismatched correspondences are preliminarily filtered, and translation estimation, a linear problem, can be easily solved. Furthermore, to obtain accurate pose results, we introduce a novel pose refinement algorithm to enhance the accuracy of both rotation and translation. Extensive experiments on synthetic data and three publicly available real-world datasets (TUM RGB-D, ETH3D, and RobotCar) demonstrate that the proposed method achieves stronger performance compared to existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches. To further validate our method, we integrated it into ORB-SLAM2. The results on the KITTI dataset show it effectively reduces drift and improves trajectory alignment during relocalization. Abstract: Accurate tilt angle estimation is important in many engineering applications, such as robotics, motion tracking, and embedded control systems. We further introduce a spatial contrastive learning strategy that aligns 3D features corresponding to the same human instance across different views and modalities while separating different instances. Specifically, given the current state, ReBridge-Flow first decodes the corresponding local source and clean endpoints. A confidence-routed AR-CTC ensemble adds a directionally consistent +0.6 pt that stays within noise, and its dominant learned coefficient is each model's own minimum-softmax confidence--independently echoing the mechanism above. Abstract: Whether attention weights faithfully reflect model reasoning has been actively debated in NLP, yet this question remains largely unexplored for the visual modality in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Abstract: Vision-language models are evaluated by aggregate accuracy on multimodal benchmarks, a practice that implicitly assumes the model uses its visual input. We name this phenomenon the Visual Insensitivity Gap and quantify it with a per-sample Visual Sensitivity Index (VSI). The gap is a property of samples, not of models: VSI ranks correlate across models (grand-mean Spearman rho=+0.40, permutation p<10^-3), so the same samples are flagged insensitive by VLMs sharing no architectural detail beyond a contrastively pretrained vision tower. The mechanism is concrete: on the insensitive samples, a linear probe on each model's own vision tower distinguishes perturbed from clean images at 0.72--0.79 accuracy, yet the model's argmax token changes on only 2%--11% of the same samples, an encoder--LLM gap above 0.65 on every model.   <summary>Details</summary>

Our results highlight the effectiveness of terminology-grounded instruction generation as a general strategy for improving vision-language reasoning in scientific domains. To support future research in scientific diagram understanding, we release both the SciGram dataset and models.

Abstract: Collaborative perception shares information among multiple agents to obtain a comprehensive scene representation, enhancing the perceptual capability of individual agents. In CERF, we introduce a new virtual modality (termed Poture), which is generated from the perception outputs of other agents, to augment the extracted Bird's Eye View (BEV) features of the ego agent. To mitigate transmission delays, we employ a Kalman-filter based tracker and a motion forecasting model to derive the current predictions from historical perception results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CERF achieves performance comparable to mainstream intermediate-collaboration methods while reducing communication overhead by 95% across various downstream tasks. Furthermore, CERF enables seamless integration of unknown heterogeneous agents into the existing collaborative framework without additional retraining costs. Code is available at https://github.com/uestchjw/CERF.

</details>

*Yuannuo Feng,Yizhe Chen,Wenshuai Yao,Yuxin Xie,Ngai Wong,Wenyong Zhou,Wang Kang*

TL;DR: 本文研究了扩散模型在模拟存内计算（CIM）硬件上的噪声鲁棒性，发现早期高噪声去噪阶段对硬件噪声更敏感，并提出了一种免训练的采样器ASSERT，通过早期注入更高随机性并平滑过渡到确定性去噪，有效缓解了硬件噪声引起的性能退化。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Diffusion models achieve strong image generation quality but incur high iterative denoising costs. A first-order trajectory analysis attributes this behavior to the repeated propagation of correlated prediction errors induced by a fixed hardware mapping. Based on this observation, we propose ASSERT, a training-free sampler that uses higher stochasticity early and smoothly transitions to deterministic denoising. The injected stochasticity changes subsequent activation trajectories and thereby reduces their alignment with persistent spatial errors. Across the evaluated settings, ASSERT achieves up to 2.58$\times$ lower FID than deterministic DDIM on high-resolution datasets and 7.68$\times$ lower FID in the CIFAR-10 step-count study, without changing model parameters or the number of network evaluations.

</details>


### [64] [PredErase: Training-Free Object-and-Effect Removal with Predictive Latent Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00956)
*Waikit Xiu,Qiang Lu,Junbiao Chen,Xiying Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PredErase是一种无需训练的推理过程，基于冻结的FLUX.2和I-JEPA模型实现物体及其附带效果（接触阴影、投射阴影）的联合擦除，解决了仅填充实例掩码无法去除物体在周围表面"光度足迹"的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移除物体并不等同于填充其掩码。物体投射的阴影和接触阴影通常位于用户提供的实例掩码M_obj之外，冻结的Fill模型仅编辑该掩码区域会遗漏物体在邻近表面上的光度痕迹。监督式移除方法需要成对干净底板数据，而训练自由编辑方法虽冻结预训练权重，却大多仍将M_obj视为全部可编辑支撑区域，用不预测遮挡场景的CLIP或DINO能量引导采样。现有方法缺乏对"何处可改写像素"与"洞中应填何种结构"的分离处理。

Method: PredErase将擦除分解为两个问题：何处Fill可改写像素、洞中应填什么结构。具体包括：(1) 对M_obj做接触带扩展得到M_flux，暴露支撑平面上的局部残差；(2) 利用I-JEPA（预训练用于掩码token预测）在表示空间中提供上下文条件化的洞目标；(3) 通过稀疏投影梯度使解码的Fill补全在实例内部与该目标对齐，而打包支撑区域外的坐标保持锁定。

Result: 在RemovalBench、RORD-Val和DEFACTO-Val数据集上，仅使用实例级掩码，PredErase比原生FLUX.2主干的性能有所提升。监督式移除方法在若干全局图像外观指标上仍然更强，因此论文支持的声明是：对冻结Fill模型实现免训练的物体及其效果编辑，而非替代基于成对数据的擦除器。

Conclusion: PredErase证明利用预训练的I-JEPA表示空间可以为物体移除提供上下文洞目标，并通过扩展接触带处理掩码外阴影，实现免训练的物体与效果联合擦除。其定位是补充而非取代监督式擦除方法。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Mixed-format medical visual question answering (VQA) requires stable option selection and machine-readable free-text output.   <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 将问题建模为条件流匹配路径：源与目标体素已空间配准，直接学习将源切片携带至目标切片的速度场（而非从噪声出发）。训练分三阶段：(1) 退化桥接预训练，从丰富的无配对回溯队列中蒸馏恢复先验；(2) 在所有定向对上使用配对队列进行跨场微调；(3) 对抗精炼锐化输出。推理时以二阶Heun求解器少量步数积分学习到的速度场。

Result: 仅凭无配对数据学习的恢复先验已达平均SSIM 0.837，每增加一个训练阶段均有提升。单一6.3M参数模型覆盖全部60种场强-对比度组合，每切片5步推理。在挑战评估集上，三种对比度平均SSIM达0.909，在全部三个挑战指标上均优于基于相同网络的回归和扩散基线。

Abstract: Magnetic resonance images of the same subject look markedly different across field strengths, which complicates the comparison and pooling of data across sites. We phrase the problem as a conditional flow matching path: because the source and target volumes are spatially registered, we learn a velocity field that carries the source slice directly to the target slice, rather than starting from noise. To learn this mapping from only three paired subjects, the unified model is trained in three stages: a degradation-bridge pretraining that distills a restoration prior from the abundant unpaired retrospective cohort, a cross-field finetuning over all directed pairs on the paired cohort, and an adversarial refinement that sharpens the output. At inference, we integrate the learned velocity with a second-order Heun solver in a handful of steps. A restoration prior learned without any paired data already reaches a mean SSIM of 0.837, and each subsequent training stage improves on it. A single 6.3M-parameter model thereby covers all 60 field-pair and contrast combinations, with inference in five solver steps per slice. On the challenge evaluation set the model reaches a mean SSIM of 0.909, averaged over the three contrasts, outperforming regression and diffusion baselines built on the identical network on all three challenge metrics.

</details>


### [67] [ReFlowSET: Representation-Aligned Latent Flow Matching for SAR-to-EO Image Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00968)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SAR到EO图像翻译方法通常直接继承在自然图像上预训练的自编码器，但不同codec在不同模态间重建保真度差异显著，而codec选择对SAR条件和EO目标的往返保持至关重要，却被现有方法所忽视。

Method: 1) 通过联合SAR-EO重建审计来选择的潜空间codec；2) 不继承重型预训练生成器，而是在选定潜空间中从头训练较小的条件DiT；3) 采用双流SAR条件输入和联合特征精炼；4) 利用冻结的视觉基础模型将中间噪声EO特征与干净目标EO特征对齐，提供语义引导，该对齐仅在训练期间使用。

Abstract: SAR-to-EO image translation aims to generate electro-optical (EO) imagery from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations. Existing latent diffusion approaches typically inherit a predetermined autoencoder, although reconstruction fidelity can vary substantially across codecs and modalities. Because the latent codec affects the round-trip preservation of both SAR conditions and EO targets, codec selection constitutes a fundamental design choice; nevertheless, existing methods largely rely on codecs pretrained on natural images. To remedy this, we introduce ReFlowSET, a conditional latent flow-matching framework that selects its codec through a joint SAR--EO reconstruction audit. Rather than inheriting a heavyweight pretrained generator, ReFlowSET trains a substantially smaller conditional DiT from scratch in the selected latent space, using dual-stream SAR conditioning followed by joint feature refinement. To provide semantic guidance for this from-scratch training, intermediate noisy-EO features are aligned with clean target-EO representations extracted by a frozen vision foundation model. This alignment is used only during training and introduces no additional inference cost. Experiments on QXS-SAROPT and SAR2Opt demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across diverse perceptual fidelity and distributional metrics. Code and pretrained weights are publicly available at https://github.com/KAIST-VICLab/ReFlowSET.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在H&E到IHC（Ki67和HER2）以及FFPE到H&E的翻译任务上，方法在图像质量、形态保持、鲁棒性及下游诊断性能方面均取得一致改进。

Conclusion: 通过形态保持与真实性约束的协同作用，有效解决了半监督虚拟染色中未配对图像监督缺失导致的训练崩溃与结果失真问题，提升了虚拟染色的实用性与诊断相关性。

Abstract: Virtual staining aims to computationally generate target-stained histopathological images while reducing the cost and time associated with conventional staining procedures. However, existing methods rely predominantly on strictly paired and accurately registered training data, which are difficult and expensive to obtain in routine practice. To reduce this dependence, we propose a stable semi-supervised virtual staining framework that jointly exploits both limited paired data and abundant unpaired source images. Directly incorporating unpaired images is challenging because their generated results lack corresponding targets for supervision, potentially leading to unrealistic staining, morphological degradation, or even training collapse. To obtain reliable supervision from these images, Hessian-derived morphology preservation extracts structural cues from each source image and constrains the generated output to retain tissue morphology. Histopathological realism constraints further guide the output toward plausible target-stain characteristics, preventing the source-derived structural supervision from degenerating into contour enhancement or simple color transformation. Together, the two components suppress structural and appearance drift, stabilize semi-supervised stain translation, and promote the preservation of diagnostically relevant information. Extensive experiments on H&E-to-IHC translation for Ki67 and HER2, as well as FFPE-to-H&E translation, demonstrate consistent improvements in image quality, morphology preservation, robustness, and downstream diagnostic performance. </details>


### [69] [EvoGS: Modeling Deformation Evolution for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00994)
*Wei Dong,Shahram Shirani,Jun Chen,Han Zhou*

TL;DR: EvoGS是一种基于3D高斯泼溅的动态场景重建框架，将高斯变形建模为时间演化过程，通过持久化变形状态、历史状态外推未来状态以及MLP观测校正来处理大或突变的运动，并引入变形感知的稠密化策略提升重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于MLP的动态3DGS方法在每个时间戳独立估计高斯变形，缺乏时间上的连贯性，因此对大幅或突发运动不够鲁棒。作者希望利用时间维度上的历史信息来提升动态场景重建的稳健性。

Result: EvoGS在动态新视角合成质量上取得提升，并在多个基准数据集上达到具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 通过将高斯变形视为时间演化过程而非独立估计，EvoGS有效增强了对大幅或突变运动的鲁棒性，验证了时间演化建模在动态场景重建中的有效性。

Abstract: Recent extensions of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enable real-time novel view synthesis in dynamic scenes by learning time-conditioned Gaussian deformations. However, existing MLP-based methods typically estimate deformations independently at each timestamp, making them less robust to large or abrupt motions. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{EvoGS}, a 3DGS-based dynamic reconstruction framework that models Gaussian deformation as a temporal evolution process. EvoGS maintains persistent deformation states for each Gaussian, extrapolates future states from historical deformation states, and corrects the predictions with MLP-derived observations. The correction is adaptively weighted using a temporal residual memory and evolution statistics such as deformation velocity and trajectory deviation. To further improve reconstruction quality, EvoGS introduces deformation-aware densification. Clone and split operations are performed along corrected deformation directions, while an uncertainty-aware strategy suppresses densification for Gaussians with unstable deformation histories. Experiments show that EvoGS improves dynamic novel view synthesis quality and achieves competitive performance across benchmarks.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 四元数约束的连续归一化流是概率性3D人体姿态估计的有效框架，相比其他旋转表示更具优势，能够在模糊场景中生成合理且高质量的3D数字人姿态。

Abstract: Recovering 3D digital humans from a single 2D image is an ill-posed computer vision problem due to the loss of depth information. Probabilistic 3D human pose estimation compensates for this by estimating a set of 3D hypotheses from a prior distribution via generative models. However, most prior work focuses only on 3D keypoints, which often leads to implausible poses that are difficult to apply to downstream tasks, e.g. animation or digital humans. SMPL-based methods are more scalable thanks to the explicit body priors, but it requires more complex modeling of the generation process due to the non-additive nature of the joint rotations. In this work, we propose a novel approach for probabilistic 3D humans using quaternion-constrained continuous normalizing flows conditioned on 2D pose estimations. Our proposed quaternion flows show significant advantages over approaches using other rotation representations. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art results of our method on Human3.6M, particularly in ambiguous settings, and comparable pose estimation accuracy on challenging 3DPW and EMDB benchmarks.

</details>


### [71] [Does This Moment Justify the Recommendation? Counterfactual Behavior-Grounded Evidence Retrieval for Personalized Video Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00996)
*Xin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出反事实行为驱动的证据检索任务（CBGER），区分"个性化证据发生位置"（Where）与"是否存在个性化证据"（Whether），并构建了包含5000个受控事实-反事实对的CBGER-10K数据集，提出CBGER框架解耦段级定位与视频级证据估计，实验表明精确的时间定位并不等同于可靠的个性化证据存在性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化视频推荐在视频级别预测用户偏好，而时间视频定位则定位与查询相关的时刻。然而，强定位能力并不能证明检索到的时刻构成推荐该视频给特定用户的有效证据。现有方法忽略了"证据是否存在"与"证据在哪里"之间的语义差异，需要显式建模反事实行为证据检索。

Method: 提出CBGER-10K数据集，包含3,026个用户的5,000对受控事实-反事实样本对，每对仅替换关键的行为支撑片段，同时保留用户、时间位置和干扰项。提出CBGER框架，将段级定位与视频级证据估计解耦，并通过结构化反事实监督联合学习两个任务。

Result: CBGER在五个适应的个性化高亮和时间定位基线上取得0.4432 MRR、0.6977 Pair Accuracy和0.6987 Intervention Consistency。与QD-DETR相比，MRR提升无统计显著性，但Pair Accuracy提升11.03个百分点。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，准确的时间定位并不一定意味着可靠的个性化证据存在性推断，这激励在评估中显式区分"Whether"（是否存在）与"Where"（在哪里）两个维度，以更全面地评测个性化视频推荐中的证据检索能力。

Abstract: Personalized video recommendation predicts user preference at the video level, while temporal video grounding localizes query-relevant moments. However, strong localization does not establish whether the retrieved moment constitutes valid evidence for recommending the video to a particular user. We study counterfactual behavior-grounded evidence retrieval, which separates where personalized evidence occurs from whether such evidence exists and evaluates whether model predictions respond consistently when that evidence is replaced. We introduce CBGER-10K, containing 5,000 controlled factual--counterfactual pairs for 3,026 users, where each pair replaces only the focal behavior-supported segment while preserving the user, temporal position, and hard distractors. We further propose CBGER, a compact framework that decouples segment-level localization from video-level evidence estimation and learns both through structured counterfactual supervision. CBGER achieves $0.4432$ MRR, $0.6977$ Pair Accuracy, and $0.6987$ Intervention Consistency across five adapted personalized-highlight and temporal-grounding baselines. Notably, compared with QD-DETR, its MRR improvement is not statistically significant, while Pair Accuracy improves by $11.03$ points. These results show that accurate temporal localization does not necessarily imply reliable personalized evidence existence, motivating explicit evaluation of Whether alongside Where.

</details>


### [72] [SinkPruner: Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01004)
*Shiyu Li,Zi-Yuan Hu,Shijia Huang,Yanyang Li,Yiwu Zhong,Liwei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SinkPruner是一个无需训练的视觉token剪枝框架，通过粗到细的两阶段设计（视觉清洗器+文本引导剪枝器）高效降低多模态大语言模型的推理成本，在89%的token削减下仍保持96.5%的原始性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的MLLM视觉token剪枝方法（无论是视觉中心还是文本引导策略）往往忽视了高范数离群token——这类token在特征和空间维度上都高度冗余，但现有方法却常将其误认为信息丰富的线索而保留，导致剪枝决策次优。

Method: SinkPruner采用粗到细的设计，包含两个关键模块：(1) 视觉清洗器（visual sanitizer）：过滤高范数冗余token，缓解注意力汇（attention sink）和注意力分散问题；(2) 文本引导剪枝器（text-guided pruner）：进一步保留与文本查询语义对齐的token。整体为无需训练的框架。

Result: 在12个图像-语言和4个视频-语言基准上验证了有效性、效率和泛化性。在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5-VL上分别以89%的token削减保留了96.5%和91.8%的原始性能。此外，视觉清洗器在增强现有剪枝方法性能方面表现出良好的可迁移性。

Conclusion: SinkPrunner证明高范数离群token在MLLM推理中是高度冗余的，通过清洗这些token并配合文本引导剪枝，可以在大幅削减计算成本的同时保持模型性能，且其模块具有良好的可迁移性。

Abstract: Despite their strong multimodal understanding ability, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial computational overhead when processing long visual token sequences. To reduce inference costs, recent studies have explored visual token pruning through vision-centric or text-guided strategies. However, these methods often overlook high-norm outlier tokens, i.e., tokens with abnormally large feature norms, leading to suboptimal pruning decisions. In this work, we show that such high-norm outlier tokens are highly redundant in both feature and spatial dimensions, yet are often mistakenly preserved as informative cues by existing methods.
  Motivated by this observation, we propose SinkPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient MLLM inference. SinkPruner follows a coarse-to-fine design with two key modules: a visual sanitizer that filters high-norm redundancies and alleviates attention sink and attention dispersion, and a text-guided pruner that further retains tokens semantically aligned with the text query.
  Extensive experiments on twelve image-language and four video-language benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and generalizability of our framework. Notably, SinkPruner preserves 96.5% (91.8%) of the original performance of LLaVA-1.5 (Qwen2.5-VL) under an 89% token reduction. Experiments further indicate that our visual sanitizer exhibits promising transferability in enhancing the performance of existing pruning methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/LaVi-Lab/SinkPruner.

</details>


### [73] [Low-Quality Face Recognition using Center Aligned Representations and Local Margin Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01014)
*Vedat Can Dilaver,Benjamin S. Riggan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个统一框架解决低质量人脸识别（LQFR）问题，包含三个核心组件：局部概率边际（LPM）估计样本难度、嵌套注意力模块（NAM）作为低秩适配器嵌入Transformer层、质量门控协议（QGP）利用图像质量评估器在测试时调节适配器贡献，从而在不牺牲高质量（HQ）性能的前提下处理全质量谱系的人脸识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低质量人脸识别仍具挑战性，主要因为：1) 退化查询图像与低质量注册图像之间的匹配困难；2) 大规模模型训练数据稀缺。现有FR模型在高质量图像上表现良好，但在极低信噪比的低质量图像上准确率显著下降。此外，在低质量数据上微调HQ预训练模型虽能提升低质量识别，却以牺牲HQ泛化为代价，这一权衡在跨多数据集、多质量等级的现代评测中更为突出。

Method: 提出统一框架，包含三个组件：(1) LPM（局部概率边际）——直接从模型的判别空间中估计每个样本的难度；(2) NAM（嵌套注意力模块）——一种新的低秩适配器，在选定的Transformer层内嵌入自注意力机制；(3) QGP（质量门控协议）——使用现成的图像质量估计器在测试时调节适配器的贡献，使单一模型能够覆盖完整质量范围。

Result: 在监控场景（TinyFace、SurvFace）和标准人脸识别基准（IJB-B、IJB-C）上的实验表明，该框架在识别（identification）和验证（verification）任务上均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: 该框架通过统一处理不同质量等级的图像，有效解决了低质量人脸识别中HQ泛化与LQ性能之间的权衡问题，实现单一模型覆盖全质量谱系，无需牺牲HQ性能。

Abstract: Low-quality face recognition (LQFR) remains challenging due to the difficulty of matching degraded query (probe) images against low-quality (LQ) enrollment (gallery) imagery and the scarcity of training data for large-scale models. While recent face recognition (FR) models perform well on high-quality (HQ) imagery, their accuracy drops significantly on LQ images with extremely low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Moreover, fine-tuning HQ-pretrained models on LQ data often improves LQ recognition at the expense of HQ generalization. This trade-off becomes more pronounced in modern evaluation settings spanning multiple datasets with varying image quality levels. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework that combines three main components: (1) Local Probability Margin (LPM), which estimates per-sample difficulty directly from the model's discriminative landscape; (2) Nested Attention Module (NAM), a new low-rank adapter module that embeds a self-attention mechanism within selected transformer layers; and (3) Quality Gating Protocol (QGP), where an off-the-shelf image quality estimator modulates the adapter contribution at test time, enabling a single model to handle the full quality spectrum without sacrificing HQ performance. Experiments on surveillance (TinyFace, SurvFace) and standard (IJB-B, IJB-C) face recognition benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in both identification and verification. Code and models will be released at github.com/candllq/nam.

</details>


### [74] [Fi-ImageNet-1k: An OOD Benchmark From the Inside of the ImageNet-1k Validation Set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01027)
*Ruslan Rozumnyi,Matěj Suchánek,Tomáš Vojíř,Klára Janoušková,Jiří Matas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Fi-ImageNet-1k，一个利用ImageNet-1k验证集中注释错误构建的OOD检测基准数据集。通过ReImageNet重注释和专家人工审核，筛选出655张不属于任何ImageNet-1k类别的图像，该数据集比现有常用OOD数据集更具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的OOD检测基准通常以临时方式定义或收集OOD图像，缺乏系统性。作者指出ID标记数据集中本身含有天然的OOD图像（即注释错误），可以将其作为更真实、更具挑战性的OOD检测测试资源。

Method: 基于ImageNet-1k验证集中被ReImageNet重注释为不属于任何ImageNet-1k类别的图像构建数据集。每张图像由专家人类注释者结合MLLMs、VLMs和反向图像搜索的证据进行审查，并与所有视觉上相似的ID类别对比，仅保留可被分配到ImageNet-1k标签空间之外特定类别的图像。

Result: 构建了包含655张来自522个类别的Fi-ImageNet-1k数据集。该数据集比常用OOD数据集更具挑战性：所有评估的分类器和OOD检测器组合在95%真阳性率下假阳性率均不低于51%。与NINCO相比，在FPR@95指标上对最先进的监督OOD检测方法挑战性高出3.8倍。

Conclusion: Fi-ImageNet-1k提供了更具挑战性和真实性的OOD检测基准，揭示了现有OOD检测方法在接近真实世界OOD场景中的显著性能差距。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection predicts whether a test image belongs to none of the predefined classes. To evaluate this task, benchmarks need images from outside the in-distribution (ID) data; typically, these are defined or collected in an ad hoc fashion. Since no ground truth is perfect, ID-labeled datasets themselves contain a natural source of OOD images. We exploit such annotation errors and present Fi-ImageNet-1k, an OOD dataset built from ImageNet-1k validation images that the recent ReImageNet reannotation effort assigned to no ImageNet-1k class. Each image was examined by expert human annotators supported by evidence from MLLMs, VLMs, and reverse image search, comparing it against all visually similar ID classes. We keep only images that could be assigned a specific class outside the ImageNet-1k label space.
  The resulting Fi-ImageNet-1k, with 655 images from 522 classes, is substantially more challenging than any commonly used OOD dataset. No evaluated combination of classifier and OOD detector achieves a false positive rate below 51% at 95% true positive rate (FPR@95). Compared to the recent NINCO, our dataset is 3.8x more challenging in the FPR@95 metric for state-of-the-art supervised OOD detection methods.

</details>


### [75] [ViTAMINS: An Empirical Study of Training Self-Supervised Vision Transformers with Synthetic Hard Negatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01041)
*Nikos Giakoumoglou,Andreas Floros,Kleanthis-Marios Papadopoulos,Tania Stathaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViTAMINS是一种将合成困难负样本整合到无监督视觉Transformer预训练中的方法，通过简单修改现有对比学习框架，在ImageNet及多项下游任务上显著提升表示质量，甚至能催生语义信息的涌现特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望挑战当前生成式（如V-JEPA）和自蒸馏方法在视觉预训练中的主导地位，探讨对比学习是否可以通过恰当设计的负样本策略成为一种更简单但同样强大的替代方案。

Method: 在现有的无监督对比学习框架中，引入了"合成困难负样本"（synthetic hard negatives），即通过合成方式生成与正样本语义相近但类别不同的样本作为负样本，以增强模型学习表征的判别力。

Result: 在ImageNet、迁移学习、图像检索、拷贝检测、图像/视频分割等任务上全面超越基线；学习到的表征包含显式语义信息并可充当优秀分类器（较基线最高提升+11.3%）；ViT-B版本即超越使用ViT-L的V-JEPA，且更节省资源。

Conclusion: 对比学习通过引入合成困难负样本，能够在保持资源效率的同时达到甚至超越更复杂的生成式和自蒸馏方法，值得重新审视对比学习作为视觉预训练核心范式的价值。

Abstract: We introduce ViTAMINS, a method that integrates synthetic hard negatives into unsupervised vision transformer pretraining to improve representation quality. Our approach is thoroughly benchmarked on ImageNet and transfer learning, image retrieval, copy detection, and image, video segmentation tasks. Notably, our proposed negatives give rise to emergent properties, where learned representations contain explicit information about the semantic content of an image and serve as excellent classifiers (up to +11.3% over baselines). ViTAMINS achieves these benefits through simple modifications to existing contrastive frameworks and outperforms competing methods while being more resource efficient, e.g., our ViT-B surpasses V-JEPA with ViT-L. Our findings motivate reconsidering contrastive learning as a simpler yet powerful alternative to dominant generative and self-distillation approaches.

</details>


### [76] [Dyn-3D: Unveiling and Resolving Ego-Motion Ambiguity in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01059)
*Jiayu Ding,Zhuodong Liu,Lei Zhang,Manyu Xiong,Hongbo Jin,Haoran Tang,Hongbo Zhang,Changen Zhu,Wenbo Xing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对VLM在动态3D空间推理中的"运动学崩溃"问题，提出Dyn-3D基准测试和TempoVista框架（含Kinematic-GSPO算法），通过反事实3D渲染解耦视觉变化与真实运动学属性，并将度量物理真值嵌入策略优化中，显著提升运动估计和空间推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在动态3D空间推理中存在单目尺度模糊问题，需要自我运动感知来解决。然而当前模型过度拟合平滑轨迹先验而非真正理解物理运动，导致在大位移下空间推理严重退化（Kinematic Collapse）。这一失效源于自然视频中虚假的视觉-运动相关性以及缺乏显式物理监督。

Method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) Dyn-3D基准测试：利用反事实3D渲染严格解耦视觉变化与真实运动学属性，用于评估模型的运动学理解能力；(2) TempoVista框架：包含Kinematic-GSPO算法，将度量物理真值嵌入策略优化中，显式将视觉表征锚定在3D空间中，利用相机动态作为几何校准信号。

Result: 实验表明该方法在运动估计和鲁棒空间推理方面均取得显著提升，验证了利用相机动态作为有效几何校准信号的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将显式物理监督引入VLM训练，并结合反事实渲染基准进行评估，可以有效缓解Kinematic Collapse问题，使模型从依赖轨迹先验转向真正理解物理运动。

Abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) tackle dynamic 3D spatial reasoning, ego-motion perception becomes essential to resolve monocular scale ambiguity. However, current models often overfit to smooth trajectory priors rather than genuinely understanding physical motion. Consequently, their spatial reasoning degrades severely under large displacements, a phenomenon we term Kinematic Collapse. This failure stems from spurious visual-motion correlations in natural videos and a lack of explicit physical supervision. To evaluate this, we introduce Dyn-3D, a benchmark using counterfactual 3D rendering to rigorously decouple visual changes from true kinematic properties. Furthermore, we propose the TempoVista framework, featuring the Kinematic-GSPO algorithm. By embedding metric physical ground truth into policy optimization, TempoVista explicitly grounds visual representations in 3D space. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves both motion estimation and robust spatial reasoning by utilizing camera dynamics as an effective geometric calibration signal.

</details>


### [77] [IT-TextFusion: Iterative Text-Image Interaction with Text-Guided Residual Refinement for Degradation-Aware Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01092)
*Siyang Liu,Peiyi Zhou,Tianle Jin,Rongrong Bian,Zheke Jin,Mengze Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种迭代式文本引导图像融合框架，通过多个融合和细化阶段引入文本条件特征交互，利用全局文本嵌入对层级特征融合和残差细化进行条件控制，以增强可见光与红外图像的融合效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本引导图像融合方法依赖浅层语义-视觉交互和有限的注意力机制，难以稳健处理复杂退化情况，且无法充分利用文本引导信息。

Method: 提出迭代式文本引导图像融合框架，包含三层核心机制：最深层的交叉注意力（Cross-Attention）、多尺度交叉门控融合（Cross-Gate Fusion）、以及逐阶段文本条件调制（stage-specific text-conditioned modulation）。通过在各层级解码器和细化阶段反复注入池化后的文本嵌入，实现退化感知的全局语义条件控制。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多项信息保持和感知质量指标上取得提升，但在部分数据集上表现出与指标相关的权衡。

Conclusion: 该框架通过反复注入池化文本嵌入到层级融合和细化阶段，为图像融合提供了全局语义条件控制，同时有效保留了可见光与红外模态的互补信息，验证了文本引导在多阶段融合中的有效性。

Abstract: Text-guided image fusion has recently emerged as an effective paradigm for integrating multi-modal information while enabling flexible and task-oriented fusion control. However, existing text-guided fusion methods often rely on shallow semantic-visual interaction and limited attention mechanisms, which restrict their ability to robustly handle complex degradations and fully exploit textual guidance. In this paper, we propose an iterative text-guided image fusion framework that incorporates text-conditioned feature interaction across multiple fusion and refinement stages. The proposed method integrates deepest-level Cross-Attention, multi-scale Cross-Gate Fusion, and stage-specific text-conditioned modulation, allowing the global text embedding to condition hierarchical feature fusion and residual refinement. By repeatedly injecting the pooled text embedding across hierarchical decoder and refinement stages, the proposed framework provides degradation-aware global semantic conditioning while preserving complementary information from the visible and infrared modalities. Experiments on several benchmark datasets show that the proposed method improves several information-preservation and perceptual-quality metrics, while exhibiting metric-dependent trade-offs on some datasets.

</details>


### [78] [P-PatchDiff: Progressive Patch Diffusion Models for Low-light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01123)
*Ruoyu Guo,Haonan Zhong,Maurice Pagnucco,Yang Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出P-PatchDiff，一种可扩展的渐进式补丁扩散框架，用于低光图像增强。该方法在去噪过程中动态调整补丁大小，实现从局部到全局视野的渐进过渡，并结合多补丁对齐策略，通过全局亮度代理归一化不同补丁尺度的特征。相比现有补丁扩散模型快80倍，内存低于9GB，支持从400×600到4K分辨率的图像增强，且能实现跨区域一致的亮度增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低光增强扩散模型依赖小而固定的补丁（如64×64），无法捕捉图像级亮度上下文；而增大感受野虽能改善亮度与色彩估计但计算成本过高。此外，低光图像区域亮度不均，局部增强补丁拼接成全图时需要保持视觉一致性，现有方法难以同时满足可扩展性、计算效率与全局亮度一致性。

Method: 1) 提出渐进式补丁扩散框架P-PatchDiff，在去噪过程中动态调整补丁尺寸，实现从局部到全局视野的渐进过渡；2) 引入多补丁对齐策略（Multi-Patch Alignment），利用估计的全局亮度代理对不同补丁尺度的特征进行归一化；3) 不追求像素级重建精度，而是注重可扩展性与全图亮度连贯性，使模型感知多尺度信息并更好地增强亮度不一的区域。

Result: 实验证明P-PatchDiff能有效增强从400×600到4K分辨率范围的图像，比现有补丁扩散模型快80倍，且内存占用低于9GB。

Conclusion: P-PatchDiff通过动态补丁尺寸与全局亮度代理对齐，在保证计算效率与内存可控的前提下实现了多尺度信息感知和全图亮度一致性，为低光图像增强提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advancements in low-light image enhancement have leveraged diffusion models for their strong ability to generate perceptually realistic, detailed images. Patch diffusion models further offer a promising solution to size-agnostic image restoration while improving efficiency. However, existing methods typically rely on small, fixed patches (e.g., 64$\times$64) that cannot capture image-level brightness context, whereas enlarging the receptive field improves brightness and colour estimation but substantially increases computational cost. Moreover, low-light images often exhibit uneven brightness across regions, making it necessary to ensure that locally enhanced patches remain visually coherent when combined into the full image. To address these limitations, we propose P-PatchDiff, a scalable progressive patch diffusion framework for low-light image enhancement that dynamically adjusts patch size throughout the denoising process, enabling a gradual shift from local to global views. A Multi-Patch Alignment strategy is also introduced to normalise features across varying patch scales using an estimated global brightness proxy. Rather than pursuing pixel-level reconstruction accuracy, P-PatchDiff focuses on scalability and coherent brightness across the whole image, allowing the model to perceive multi-scale information and better enhance regions with varying brightness. We empirically demonstrate that P-PatchDiff effectively enhances images ranging from 400 $\times$ 600 to 4K and is 80$\times$ faster than existing patch diffusion models while using less than 9GB of memory. The code is available at https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/P-PatchDiff.

</details>


### [79] [Different Changes Require Different Reasoning: Change-Type-Specialized Experts for Robust Change Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01136)
*Jiyoung Park,InJae Oh,Jung Uk Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MEDIC框架通过显式建模变化类别，引入类型特化的记忆专家来动态检索相关视觉模式，实现更精确的、类型感知的图像变化描述生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像变化描述方法忽略了不同变化类型（如颜色变化、物体添加）具有不同的视觉线索和推理需求，未能区分处理这些类型间的差异。

Method: 提出MEDIC框架，包含类型特化的记忆专家，这些专家根据输入条件动态检索相关视觉模式；通过软路由机制将输入分配到不同类型特化的专家，并为每个变化类别学习专属表示。

Result: 在多个多样且具有挑战性的数据集上，MEDIC一致性地优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过引入变化类型意识并采用多专家诊断机制，MEDIC能够生成更精确和类型感知的变化描述，验证了显式建模变化类别在图像变化描述任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Change captioning is the task of generating natural language descriptions that explain the changes between a pair of images. Although different change types (e.g., color shifts, object additions) exhibit distinct visual cues and require specialized reasoning processes, existing methods often overlook these distinctions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Expert Diagnosis for Image Change (MEDIC), a novel framework that introduces change-type awareness by explicitly modeling change categories. MEDIC employs type-specialized memory experts that dynamically retrieve type-relevant visual patterns conditioned on the input. This design enables each expert to capture diverse variations within its change type while focusing on the most informative visual cues. By softly routing inputs across type-specialized experts and learning dedicated representations for each change category, MEDIC generates more precise and type-aware change descriptions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MEDIC consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse and challenging datasets. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MEDIC}{GitHub}.

</details>


### [80] [Revisiting Face Recognition for Monozygotic Twins: The Celeb Twins Test Set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01141)
*Michael Zang,Haiyu Wu,Mrinal Sharma,Kevin W. Bowyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Celeb Twins Test Set (CTTS)——一个包含80组名人双胞胎图像对的测试集，该数据集是唯一包含皮肤标记和镜像不对称元数据的双胞胎测试集。研究显示当前深度CNN匹配器在CTTS上能达到76%以上的准确率，但并未利用皮肤标记或不对称特征。论文还探讨了使用生成式AI工具创建虚构同卵双胞胎图像，以增加训练集中双胞胎代表性的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双胞胎面部识别一直是人脸识别领域的难题，尤其同卵双胞胎外表极为相似。过往研究指出皮肤标记和镜像不对称可能是提升双胞胎识别精度的潜在方向，但缺乏包含这些元数据的标准测试集来验证该假设。

Method: 构建了名为Celeb Twins Test Set (CTTS)的测试集，包含网络爬取的80组名人双胞胎图像对，并按照LFW、CALFW等标准人脸验证测试集的组织方式构建。该数据集包含了区分性皮肤标记和可能镜像不对称的元数据。

Result: 当前深度CNN匹配器在CTTS上可以实现超过76%的准确率，但分析表明这些匹配器并未利用皮肤标记或不对称特征来提高识别精度。

Conclusion: 现有匹配器未有效利用皮肤标记和不对称性等双胞胎特有的判别特征，作者探讨了利用生成式AI（如Grok、ChatGPT、Gemini）生成虚构同卵双胞胎图像以扩充训练数据的可行性，为改善双胞胎人脸识别提供新思路。

Abstract: Past literature on face recognition for monozygotic (("identical") twins points to facial marks and mirror asymmetry as possible directions for improved accuracy of twins recognition. The Celeb Twins Test Set (CTTS) contains web-scraped image pairs for 80 sets of celebrity twins. It is the only twins test set with meta-data for twins with distinguishing skin marks and possible mirror asymmetry. CTTS is organized in the manner of face verification test sets such as LFW, CALFW, CPLFW, CFP-FP, and AgeDB-30. Current deep CNN matchers can achieve over 76% accuracy in classifying CTTS same-person / different-person image pairs. We show that current matchers do not make use of skin marks, or asymmetry, and discuss reasons for this. Finally, we discuss the feasibility of using generative AI tools such as Grok, ChatGPT and Gemini to create images of imagined monozygotic twins as a means to increase representation of twins in face recognition training sets.

</details>


### [81] [StainPresetNet: Stain Preset Network for Fast Multi-to-Multi Stain Normalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01146)
*Hongtao Kang,Die Luo,Li Chen,Jing Cai,Junbo Hu,Xiuli Liu,Shenghua Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StainPresetNet是一种新型染色归一化框架，结合结构保持与数据集级颜色映射，通过预设参考图像实现像素级归一化，支持多方向自适应无需重新训练，在细胞病理和组织病理数据集上优于传统方法，分类器泛化能力提升，计算开销比深度学习方案降低90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统染色归一化方法依赖单张或有限参考图像进行像素级变换，虽灵活但颜色映射提取不准确；而现有深度学习方法虽能实现精确的数据集级映射，但存在计算效率低、产生伪影、以及归一化方向固定需重训练模型等局限。作者旨在解决这些缺陷，设计兼顾结构保持、数据集级映射和高计算效率的统一框架。

Method: 提出StainPresetNet框架，核心创新在于预设参考图像引导的像素级归一化机制。该方法用结构保持结合数据集级颜色映射，通过替换参考图像即可灵活调整归一化方向而无须重新训练模型，实现了多方向自适应能力。

Result: 在细胞病理和组织病理数据集上的评估表明：(1)颜色映射精度优于传统方法；(2)有效提升诊断任务中分类器的泛化能力；(3)相比现有深度学习方法，计算开销降低约90%。

Conclusion: StainPresetNet通过预设引导机制克服了当前深度学习方法的方向固定性问题，仅通过简单替换参考图像即可实现灵活的归一化方向调整，在精度、泛化性和效率三个维度均取得显著改进，是一种具有实用价值的染色归一化新方案。

Abstract: Stain normalization reduces color variations caused by variations in staining protocols and imaging conditions, thereby enhancing computer-aided diagnostic system performance. Traditional methods derive mapping relationships from individual or limited reference images through pixel-wise transformation, offering style flexibility but suffering from inaccurate color mapping extraction. While existing deep-learning-based approaches achieve accurate dataset-wide color mapping through complex neural networks, they face challenges including computational inefficiency, artifact generation, and fixed normalization directions requiring model retraining for directional changes. To address these limitations, we propose StainPresetNet - a novel framework that combines structural preservation with dataset-level color mapping while maintaining computational efficiency. Our method implements pixel-wise normalization guided by preset reference images, enabling multi-directional adaptability without retraining. Evaluations on cytopathology and histopathology datasets demonstrate that StainPresetNet achieves superior color mapping accuracy compared to conventional methods, effectively improves classifier generalization in diagnostic tasks, and reduces computational overhead by 90\% versus existing deep learning approaches. The proposed preset-guided mechanism facilitates flexible adjustment of normalization directions through simple reference image replacement, overcoming the directional rigidity of current deep-learning-based solutions.

</details>


### [82] [On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01147)
*Chaohao Yuan,Ruifeng Yuan,Zhuoxu Huang,Yu Rong,Hong Cheng,Hou Pong Chan,Chenghao Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了Pixel Linguist II，一个原生分辨率的视觉编码器，通过四项关键设计原则（可变分辨率与字体大小、自然图文对、布局感知渲染、两阶段多语种课程学习）在280M训练样本上训练，在英文、跨语言和多语言Visual STS及ViDoRe基准上取得SOTA结果，并支持80%视觉token压缩下的稳健表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有像素文本编码器在处理富文本视觉输入时存在固定分辨率预训练、视觉捷径学习、弱视觉定位以及多语言视觉文本理解不足等核心缺陷，亟需探究稳健视觉文本表征学习的基本设计原则。

Method: 通过系统受控消融实验确定四项关键组件：(1)可变图像分辨率和渲染字体大小提供高分辨率文档泛化的空间代理；(2)自然图文对不可或缺，防止纯文本崩溃并强化grounding；(3)布局感知渲染防止像素级捷径；(4)两阶段多语言课程实现跨语言对齐。据此训练Pixel Linguist II，采用即时渲染、统一对比grounding和多语言课程策略。

Result: Pixel Linguist II在英文、跨语言及多语言Visual STS和ViDoRe基准上刷新SOTA结果，并在MLLM下游评估中表现更优；在80%视觉token压缩下仍保持稳健，展现出光学上下文压缩的巨大潜力。

Conclusion: 通过整合系统验证的设计原则，Pixel Linguist II证明了稳健视觉文本表征学习可以在资源高效（280M样本）的前提下超越现有方法，并对视觉token压缩具有强大鲁棒性，为光学上下文压缩等实际应用提供了可行的训练蓝图与开源资源。

Abstract: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resolutions and rendered font sizes provide spatial proxies for high-resolution document generalization; natural image-text pairs are indispensable for grounding and prevent text-only collapse; layout-aware rendering helps prevent pixel-level shortcuts; and a two-stage multilingual curriculum enables effective cross-lingual alignment. By integrating these principles into a scalable training recipe, we train Pixel Linguist II, a native-resolution vision encoder trained with on-the-fly rendering, unified contrastive grounding, and a multilingual curriculum over 280M training examples. Pixel Linguist II sets new state-of-the-art results on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS and ViDoRe, while also enabling better MLLM downstream evaluation. Notably, Pixel Linguist II remains robust under 80\% visual token compression, showing great promise for optical context compression. Our code and resources are available at https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.

</details>


### [83] [Dotting the Eye: An Intent-Driven Image Retouching Agent for Visual Focus Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01148)
*Chujie Qin,Zilong Zhang,Zewei Chang,Chunle Guo,Ruixing Wang,Tao Hu,Ming-Ming Cheng,Chongyi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EyeControl，一个由多模态大语言模型（MLLM）驱动的智能体系统，结合基于扩散模型的修图执行器，实现在弱用户意图（如少量点击或粗略笔画）下的视觉焦点增强修图。系统通过将用户意图与编辑区域及色调调整操作显式关联，实现"画龙点睛"式的视觉注意力引导效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的图像修饰通常仅关注整体视觉质量的色彩调整，但实际修图中还需引导观众注意力到特定主体或区域。这种焦点导向的修图需要全局和局部调整的良好协调以操纵感知显著性，同时保持视觉自然性，过程复杂且高度依赖专业经验，现有方法难以在弱用户意图下完成。

Method: EyeControl包含两大核心组件：（1）MLLM驱动的智能体，解释用户意图和图像内容，推断视觉焦点并生成结构化意图引导；（2）扩散模型修图执行器，通过将注意力图与设计的伪意图图对齐来增强对目标区域的响应，并引入操作一致性约束以改善全局与局部调整的协调，实现更自然连贯的修图效果。

Result: 作者构建了ControlArt-Bench高质量评估数据集用于视觉焦点增强任务。大量实验表明EyeControl在意图对齐和感知效果上均表现优异，产生更具吸引力且符合用户意图的修图结果。

Conclusion: EyeControl证明了通过MLLM智能体与扩散执行器的协同，可以在极简用户交互下实现专业级的视觉焦点导向修图，为智能图像编辑提供了新的范式。代码已开源。

Abstract: Image retouching is commonly formulated as enhancing overall visual quality through color adjustment, but in practice, it also serves to emphasize visual focus by guiding viewers' attention toward a specific subject or region. Achieving such focus-oriented retouching is inherently challenging, as it requires well-coordinated global and local adjustments to manipulate perceptual saliency while maintaining visual naturalness. This intricate process typically demands substantial professional expertise. In this study, we propose EyeControl, a MLLM-driven agent with a diffusion-based retouching executor that enables visual focus enhancement under weak user intent. With only a few clicks or coarse strokes, EyeControl directs visual attention to the intended region, effectively "dotting the eye" of the image. The core idea is to explicitly link the weak user intention with the target editing region and the corresponding tonal adjustment operations during retouching. To achieve this, the system first interprets the intent and image content to infer the visual focus and generate structured intent guidance for the retouching executor. Second, the retouching executor is encouraged to respond more strongly to the target region, explicitly aligning its attention map with a designed pseudo-intent map. We also introduce an operation-consistency constraint to improve coordination between global and local adjustments, achieving more natural and coherent retouching. Additionally, we contribute ControlArt-Bench, a high-quality evaluation dataset for visual focus enhancement. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that EyeControl yields perceptually appealing results with stronger intent alignment. Code can be found in https://github.com/DragonisCV/EyeControl.

</details>


### [84] [Monocular Depth Estimation from a Single Image: Progress and Opportunities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01172)
*Muxin Liu,Xiaoyang Lyu,Yang-Tian Sun,Yi-Hua Huang,Ziyi Yang,Peng Dai,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于单目深度估计的全面综述，系统梳理了该领域从早期基于学习的方法到当前基础模型时代的演变历程，涵盖问题定义、数据集、方法分类、应用场景及未来挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目深度估计是计算机视觉中的基础性难题，广泛应用于3D重建、机器人、自动驾驶和增强现实等领域。随着基础模型的兴起，该领域经历了范式转变，需要一个系统性的综述来梳理发展脉络、整合核心洞见，并为未来研究指明方向。

Method: 本文采用结构化综述方法：首先界定问题框架（区分相对深度与度量深度），介绍常用数据集（室内、室外及合成数据）；其次回顾基础模型时代之前的代表性方法并提炼核心见解；然后重点分类评述基于基础模型的方法（判别式与生成式范式），强调大规模预训练（如DINOv3）与合成数据的核心作用；最后通过定量基准与定性示例比较模型，并扩展讨论视频深度估计及应用集成。

Result: 本文系统性地比较了判别式与生成式两大类基础模型方法的代表性模型，通过定量基准和定性示例进行对比评估，并展示了深度估计在视觉SLAM、内容生成和机器人感知等实际应用中的集成效果。

Conclusion: 文章指出了领域进入基础模型时代后仍然存在的开放挑战和潜在的研究方向，为该领域未来的研究提供了参考框架。

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation has long stood as a fundamental challenge in computer vision, enabling a wide range of applications including 3D reconstruction, robotics, autonomous driving, and augmented reality. This survey traces the field's evolution from early learning-based methods to the emergence of transformative foundation models. We begin by framing the problem, distinguishing between relative and metric depth estimation, and highlighting the key challenges that have shaped a decade of research. We then present common problem formulations and introduce the most widely used datasets, covering indoor, outdoor, and synthetic data. Following this, we review major advances prior to the foundation model era, distilling core insights from influential methods that contributed to improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and robustness. The survey then turns to the recent surge of foundation-model-based approaches, categorizing them into discriminative and generative paradigms and emphasizing the critical roles of large-scale pretraining (e.g., DINOv3) and synthetic data. We compare representative models using both quantitative benchmarks and qualitative examples, and discuss natural extensions to video-based depth estimation. Further, to illustrate real-world impact, we highlight the integration of depth estimation into applications such as visual SLAM, content generation, and robot perception. Finally, we outline open challenges and promising research directions as the field advances further into the era of foundation models.

</details>


### [85] [Compressing AI Traffic: Standardized Neural Network Coding of Visual-Token Representations in Split Vision-Language Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01200)
*Reza Heidari,Hamed R. Tavakoli,Juho Kannala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探讨了VLM中视觉编码器与语言解码器跨节点运行时，中间视觉token嵌入作为"AI流量"的可压缩性。作者将ISO/IEC 15938-17神经网络编码(NNC)标准插入Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct视频问答管线的完整视觉接口，在不动权重、提示和生成的前提下，发现即使传输的BF16张量被压缩98%，视频问答精度仍接近未压缩参考值，仅在此之后才崩溃。这种鲁棒性并非源于近无损重建，而是下游推理依赖粗粒度结构和相对几何而非精确浮点值，从而论证AI流量编解码应优化率-任务而非率-失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当VLM的视觉编码器和语言解码器运行在不同计算节点时，中间视觉token嵌入不再只是内部激活，而成为需要在网络上传输的通信负载（即"AI流量"）。现有研究缺乏对这类标准化、免训练压缩方式在完整VLM视觉接口上效果的定量评估。

Method: 将ISO/IEC 15938-17 NNC编解码往返插入Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct视频问答管线的完整视觉接口（含主视觉token表示和DeepStack特征流），保持权重、提示词和生成过程不变，并在宽码率范围内扫描量化参数QP进行系统性评估。

Result: 在传输BF16张量压缩高达98%时，闭端式Video-MME精度仍接近未压缩参考值，之后才崩溃；开端式MLVU生成在LLM评判下呈现相同的"平台-崩溃"曲线。解码张量实际被重度离散化，携带显著的逐行相对L2误差，奇异值衰减比源张量更陡峭，说明鲁棒性并非源于近无损重建。

Conclusion: 下游推理依赖于张量的粗粒度结构和相对几何而非精确的浮点数值，因此AI流量编解码的优化目标应设为率-任务（rate-task）而非率-失真（rate-distortion）。

Abstract: When the visual encoder and the language decoder of a vision-language model (VLM) run on different compute nodes, the intermediate visual-token embeddings become a communicated payload rather than an internal activation. We call such machine-consumed intermediate tensors AI traffic and ask how far they can be compressed with a standardized, training-free codec. We insert ISO/IEC 15938-17 Neural Network Coding (NNC) round trips on the complete visual interface of a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct video question answering pipeline, comprising the main visual-token representation and the DeepStack feature streams, while leaving weights, prompts, and generation untouched, and sweep the quantization parameter (QP) over a wide rate range. Closed-ended Video-MME accuracy remains close to the uncompressed reference up to a 98% reduction of the transmitted BF16 tensor and only then collapses; open-ended MLVU generation shows the same plateau-and-collapse profile under an LLM judge. This robustness is not due to near-lossless reconstruction: the decoded tensor is heavily discretized, carries substantial row-wise relative L2 error, and has a visibly steeper singular-value decay than its source. Downstream reasoning therefore depends on coarse structure and relative geometry rather than exact floating-point values, which argues for rate-task rather than rate-distortion optimization of AI traffic codecs.

</details>


### [86] [S$^2$Prune: Spatially Structured Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01224)
*Yuanyuan Jia,Shunpu Tang,Qianqian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: S²Prune是一种无需训练的视觉token剪枝方法，通过区域划分保证空间覆盖，并依据Laplacian方差自适应分配token密度，最后利用首个解码块的Early Representation Change（ERC）在区域内选择代表性token。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上取得最高平均准确率，仅用32个token（原576个）仍保留79.3%的完整模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于重要性或冗余度的视觉token剪枝方法会产生跨输入的稳定空间偏差，且并不总是优于简单的均匀网格采样，说明广泛的空间覆盖具有重要价值。这促使作者思考如何在剪枝中同时兼顾空间覆盖和局部结构适配。

Method: 1) 将图像划分为多个区域，每个区域至少分配一个token以保证空间覆盖；2) 根据Laplacian方差将剩余token预算分配到结构更丰富的区域；3) 使用从第一个解码块计算的Early Representation Change (ERC)在每个区域内选取代表性token。

Result: 在多种设置和两个MLLM架构上评估，S²Prune在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上取得了所评估的无训练剪枝方法中最高的平均准确率。仅使用32个原始576个视觉token时，仍保留79.3%的完整模型性能。

Conclusion: S²Prune证明了在视觉token剪枝中，空间覆盖的保持与局部结构自适应的结合能有效超越仅依赖重要性或冗余度的方法，且无需训练即可取得优越效果。

Abstract: Visual token pruning reduces the inference overhead of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by retaining only a subset of visual tokens. Existing methods usually select tokens based on importance or redundancy. However, we observe that these criteria produce stable spatial biases across inputs and do not always outperform simple Uniform Grid sampling, highlighting the value of broad spatial coverage. Motivated by this, we propose S$^2$Prune, a training-free pruning method that preserves spatial coverage while adapting token density to local image structure. We first divide the image into regions and assign at least one token to each region to preserve coverage. The remaining token budget is then distributed according to Laplacian variation, giving more tokens to regions with richer structure. We then use Early Representation Change (ERC), computed from the first decoder block, to select representative tokens within each region. We evaluate S$^2$Prune across diverse settings and two MLLM architectures. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, it achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated training-free pruning methods. With only 32 of the original 576 visual tokens, it still retains 79.3% of the full-model performance. Code is available at https://github.com/yuanyuanjia71-spec/S2Prune.

</details>


### [87] [One Prompt Is Enough: Watermark Laundering Through Foundation Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01249)
*Jidong Yang,Qi Li,Wei Zong,Yang-Wai Chow,Willy Susilo,Huaike Yu,Chunpeng Wang,Suo Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了一个新威胁：攻击者仅通过向公开的基础图像模型提交带有重建提示的水印图像，就能获得视觉保真但水印无法解码的输出，该现象被形式化为"水印清洗"（watermark laundering）。通过联合载荷-保真度评估（BER+视觉/语义保持），在6个OpenAI和Google图像编辑模型、3种代表性水印方案及1800个重建输出上验证了该威胁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统隐形水印评估仅针对预定义的扰动（压缩、模糊、噪声、裁剪、去噪），但未考虑通过基础图像模型进行提示条件重建的实际攻击路径，导致水印安全性评估存在盲区。

Method: 形式化定义水印清洗失败模式，提出联合载荷-保真度评估框架（结合比特错误率BER与视觉/语义保持），在多种商业图像编辑模型上与多个代表性水印方案进行大规模系统评估，并包含提示消融与常规攻击对比实验。

Result: 发现两种互补的清洗机制：OpenAI模型产生最强的载荷破坏；Nano Banana 2显示DwtDct在高保真重建下仍脆弱。提示消融表明无需明确的移除导向指令即可实现载荷破坏，效果主要由重建路径本身引起。与常规攻击相比，提示条件重建构成独立且不同质地的攻击接口。

Conclusion: 基础模型重建应被纳入隐形水印评估的必要鲁棒性条件，当前评估框架缺失这一关键攻击维度。

Abstract: Invisible watermarks are typically evaluated against predefined perturbations such as compression, blur, noise, cropping, and denoising. Public foundation image models expose a distinct threat: an attacker can submit a watermarked image with a single reconstruction prompt and obtain a visually faithful output from which the invisible watermark can no longer be decoded reliably. We formalize this failure mode as watermark laundering and evaluate it using a joint payload-fidelity profile that combines bit error rate (BER) with visual and semantic preservation. Across six OpenAI and Google image editing models, three representative watermarking schemes, and 1,800 reconstructed outputs, we identify two complementary laundering regimes: OpenAI models produce the strongest payload disruption across the evaluated schemes, whereas Nano Banana 2 shows that DwtDct remains vulnerable under high-fidelity reconstruction. Prompt ablations show that no single removal-oriented instruction is necessary for payload disruption, indicating that the effect is primarily induced by the reconstruction pathway rather than by explicit attack wording. Comparisons with conventional attacks further show that prompt-conditioned reconstruction constitutes a distinct operational attack interface. These findings motivate foundation-model reconstruction as a missing robustness condition in invisible watermark evaluation.

</details>


### [88] [MeRoPE: Metric Rotary Position Embedding for Camera-Controlled Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01252)
*Zhijian Qiao,Xinjiang Wang,Jiajie Chen,Haoming Huang,Meng Li,Chih-Chung Chou,Jing Wang,Shaojie Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MeRoPE（度量旋转位置编码），一种用于相机控制视频生成的归一化保持相对相机编码方法。它通过正交旋转块编码校准光线间的相对方向、将原始度量位移映射为多频旋转相位，并沿对极弧添加视差锚定的对应先验，解决现有编码在真实度量相机轨迹中随平移基线导致注意力逻辑值无界增长的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何感知位置编码（如同质投影编码）在真实世界的度量相机轨迹上存在尺度依赖的失效模式：随着物理平移基线的增大，注意力逻辑值和特征范数会无界增长，导致模型无法稳定处理大基线轨迹和多相机光学设置下的相机控制任务。

Method: MeRoPE包含三个核心设计：1）用正交旋转块编码校准光线之间的相对方向，保持特征范数不变；2）将原始度量位移映射为多频旋转相位，无论物理平移尺度如何都保证softmax前注意力逻辑值有界；3）沿对极弧添加视差锚定的对应先验。整体严格保持特征范数，并对全局刚体坐标变换保持精确不变性。

Result: 在nuScenes（大基线轨迹）和PanShot（多样相机光学）两个数据集上，MeRoPE相比之前的位置编码方法实现了更强的相机控制能力，在旋转和平移两方面都取得了生成相机运动与条件位姿之间的最佳一致性。

Conclusion: MeRoPE通过度量感知的、范数保持的旋转位置编码方案，有效解决了相机控制视频生成中的尺度依赖失效问题，在大基线和多样光学条件下均展现出优越的性能，代码将公开提供。

Abstract: In camera-controlled video generation, geometry-aware positional encodings condition tokens on camera extrinsics and per-token viewing rays. Existing schemes, however, have a scale-dependent failure mode on real-world metric camera trajectories: homogeneous projective encodings cause attention logits and feature norms to grow unbounded with physical translation baselines. We propose MeRoPE (Metric Rotary Position Embedding), a norm-preserving relative camera encoding for attention. MeRoPE encodes relative orientations between calibrated viewing rays with orthogonal rotation blocks, maps raw metric displacements into multi-frequency rotary phases, and adds a disparity-anchored correspondence prior along the epipolar arc. This design strictly preserves feature norms, bounds pre-softmax attention logits regardless of the physical translation scale, and maintains exact invariance to global rigid coordinate changes. Across nuScenes and PanShot, which cover large-baseline trajectories and diverse camera optics, respectively, MeRoPE achieves stronger camera control than prior encodings, with the best consistency between generated camera motion and conditioning poses in both rotation and translation. Code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [89] [Seeing the World and the Self from Egocentric Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01276)
*Kai Guan,Minchao Jiang,Ruichen WangLi,Wentao Zhu,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RESELF，一个从第一视角（egocentric）视频中联合重建场景几何与穿戴者全身体运动的统一框架。它结合了确定性度量几何重建与几何条件生成模型，并通过闭环运动学反馈优化相机位姿。同时构建了EE4D-JSM数据集用于训练与评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从第一视角视频中获取完整的3D感知（包括周围场景和穿戴者的全身运动）是必要的，但现有方法通常将场景重建与运动估计分开处理：场景重建方法忽略穿戴者，而运动估计方法缺乏显式场景几何且依赖外部轨迹。由于两者存在不对称可见性和不同的预测范式（场景可见可回归，身体严重遮挡需生成推理），联合恢复具有挑战性。

Method: RESELF提出了统一框架：(1) 将基于大规模外部（exocentric）数据预训练的几何基础模型适配到egocentric视频，通过帧级尺度和相对位姿一致性目标实现；(2) 利用由此获得的相机轨迹和潜在几何特征来条件化一个扩散模型，以恢复穿戴者的运动；(3) 引入闭环运动学反馈阶段，在保持重建场景几何的同时进一步精化相机位姿。此外，还从EgoExo4D构建了EE4D-JSM数据集，对齐egocentric视频、稀疏度量场景几何、相机轨迹和全身体运动标注。

Result: 实验表明，RESELF在深度估计、相机追踪和全身体运动估计三个任务上均优于针对各单一任务设计的现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: RESELF证明将确定性场景几何重建与生成式身体运动推断相结合是可行的，能够利用任务间的不对称性进行互补，实现共享度量框架下的联合3D感知。代码、模型和数据集将公开。

Abstract: Complete 3D perception from egocentric video requires recovering the surrounding scene and the wearer's full-body motion in a shared metric frame. Existing methods typically address scene reconstruction and motion estimation separately: scene reconstruction methods ignore the wearer, whereas motion estimation methods lack explicit scene geometry and often depend on external trajectories. Joint recovery is challenging because the two tasks exhibit asymmetric visibility and require different prediction paradigms. The largely visible scene supports deterministic geometric regression, whereas the severely occluded body requires generative motion inference. We therefore propose RESELF (REconstructing the Scene and the sELF), a unified framework that couples deterministic metric geometry reconstruction with geometry-conditioned motion generation. RESELF adapts a geometry foundation model pre-trained on large-scale exocentric data to egocentric video using frame-wise scale and relative-pose consistency objectives. The resulting camera trajectory and latent geometric features condition a diffusion model that recovers the wearer's motion. A subsequent closed-loop kinematic feedback stage further refines the camera head while preserving the reconstructed scene geometry. To support training and evaluation, we curate EE4D-JSM from EgoExo4D by aligning egocentric video, sparse metric scene geometry, camera trajectories, and full-body motion annotations. Experiments show that RESELF outperforms state-of-the-art methods designed for the individual tasks across depth estimation, camera tracking, and full-body motion estimation. Code, models, and datasets will be available at https://ka1guan.github.io/RESELF/.

</details>


### [90] [HiLRP: Toward One Trustworthy Explanation for Vision Transformer: Conservation-Valid Attribution via Attention Primitives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01282)
*Sathiyamohan Nishankar,Pubudu Sanjeewani,Asanka Perera,Selvarajah Thuseethan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HiLRP，一个统一的归因框架，可适用于所有现代ViT架构变体。通过将视觉Transformer中的各种算子分解为四种基本操作类型（线性映射、双线性混合、归一化/门控、重索引），每种操作都有满足守恒性的相关性传播规则，使HiLRP能够以构造而非逐架构推导的方式支持新骨干网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT架构设计日益多样化（卷积主干、窗口/线性/多轴注意力、patch合并、空间缩减等），但现有归因方法均基于特定架构假设，无法统一适用于所有ViT变体：Grad-CAM需要末端空间特征图，注意力rollout假设全局softmax注意力，LRP需要模块特定规则。目前缺乏统一的归因框架。

Method: 将ViT中的注意力和分辨率缩减算子分解为四类基础操作：线性映射、双线性混合、归一化/门控和重索引，每类操作定义一个满足守恒性的相关性传播规则。基于这些规则，HiLRP通过构造而非逐架构推导来支持新骨干网络，并证明了守恒性与条件等变性（验证到机器精度）。

Result: 在14种归因方法和10种架构上的评估显示，没有先前方法能在所有ViT家族中保持可靠，Faithfulness Correlation对鲁棒的空间掩码骨干网络失效。HiLRP是唯一在窗口、空间缩减、多轴和线性注意力模型中保持守恒性的方法（朴素扩展会产生零或膨胀的相关性）。在EfficientViT上，HiLRP达到0.97的Pointing分数，而竞争方法仅为0.55。

Conclusion: HiLRP通过统一的底层操作分解为ViT架构空间提供了首个统一归因框架，在架构多样性和归因可靠性之间架起桥梁，并在类激活映射中定位归因失败，显著提升归因准确性。

Abstract: Vision Transformer (ViT) design has become increasingly diverse, with backbones combining convolutional stems, windowed, linear, or multi-axis attention, patch merging, and spatial reduction in various configurations. This diversity poses challenges for existing attribution methods, whose assumptions often do not hold across ViT variants: Grad-CAM requires a terminal spatial feature map, attention rollout assumes global softmax attention, and layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) requires module-specific rules. To the best of our knowledge, no existing method provides a unified attribution framework across this architectural space. We show that this architectural diversity can be captured by a simpler underlying structure.
