Further analyses show that the routing distribution changes over training and reduces unnecessary updates on low-signal or already stable samples.

</details>


### [232] [GlossoGen: Emergent Language in Complex Multi-Agent LLM Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01491)
*Elias Stengel-Eskin,Newton Sander,Carlos Bonetti,Sasha Boguraev,James Bowler,Hale Sirin,Simon Kirby*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了GlossoGen平台，用于研究多LLM智能体场景中的语言演化。通过SaveVeyru场景发现，LLM智能体之间确实会发生语言演化，产生的语言具有组合性和形态能产性，且偏离英语先验导致人类无法理解。研究识别了促成演化的关键因素（效率压力、模型强度、事后反思阶段），并发现语言传播的不同条件：新智能体可从使用中学习语言，较弱模型虽不能创造新语言但可以学习已有语言。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体之间以越来越高的频率相互交互，这引发了多智能体环境中语言演化的关键问题，涉及安全性和可监控性，以及对LLM语言学理论的影响。作者希望探究LLM智能体之间是否会产生类似人类的语言演化现象。

Method: 构建GlossoGen平台及SaveVeyru场景，该场景要求拥有部分信息的智能体在压力下进行沟通。通过实验观察语言演化是否发生，分析演化语言的特征，并系统测试影响演化的关键因素（效率压力、模型能力、事后反思阶段）以及新智能体学习语言的条件。

Result: 1) LLM智能体之间确实发生语言演化；2) 演化语言具有组合性和形态能产性；3) 语言偏离英语先验，对人类不可理解；4) 效率压力、模型强度、事后反思阶段是演化的必要条件；5) 新智能体仅从使用中学习新语言，较弱模型可以学习已有语言但无法创造新语言。

Conclusion: 当前LLM具备累积文化演化的潜力——此前仅在人类中被证实。混合智能体群体能够发展出超越其最低共同能力水平的能力，这对LLM群体安全监控和语言学研究均有重要启示。

Abstract: The growing rate at which LLM agents interact with one another raises key questions about language evolution in multi-LLM-agent settings, with implications for safety and monitorability as well as for linguistic accounts of LLMs. To address these questions, we introduce GlossoGen, a novel platform for studying multi-agent language evolution in complex scenarios. Within GlossoGen, we build the SaveVeyru scenario, which requires agents with partial information to communicate under pressure. We find that language evolution does occur between LLM agents, that the resulting languages are compositional and morphologically productive, and that they deviate from the LLMs' English prior in ways that render them incomprehensible to humans. Moreover, we identify several qualities essential to this evolution: pressure towards efficiency; the strength of the models backing the agents; and access to a "postmortem" stage in which agents can agree on linguistic conventions. Importantly, we observe that different conditions govern the transmission of language to new agents. Specifically, we find that agents learn new languages from usage alone, take an active role in this learning, and that while stronger models are required for novel language emergence, weaker models can learn an existing language once it has emerged. Taken together, our results indicate that current LLMs have the potential for cumulative cultural evolution -- previously attested only in humans -- with mixed populations of agents developing capacities that go beyond their lowest common denominator.

</details>


### [233] [Knowledge Distillation During Mid-Training Favors Reasoning over Factual Recall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01532)
*Jacqueline He,Howard Yen,Shuyue Stella Li,Margaret Li,Hanqing Zeng,Yinglong Xia,Benyu Zhang,Zhuokai Zhao,Qiang Zhang,Pang Wei Koh,Luke Zettlemoyer,Wen-tau Yih*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于logit的知识蒸馏（KD）在不同训练阶段（特别是预训练与中期训练）对小型语言模型的影响，发现前向KL蒸馏在中期训练阶段会降低事实回忆能力，并提出Switch Distillation方法，利用教师预测熵作为路由信号，仅在教师高置信度token上进行蒸馏，否则回退到交叉熵，从而在推理和知识能力上取得显著提升且不影响事实回忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管logit-based知识蒸馏被广泛用于训练小型语言模型，但其收益是否在不同训练阶段保持一致尚不清楚。本文通过受控实验揭示了前向KL蒸馏在预训练与中期训练阶段存在行为差异：虽然能提升推理能力，但在中期训练会减缓事实回忆的获取，这种阶段依赖性需要被理解和解决。

Method: 作者首先通过受控实验发现前向KL蒸馏在预训练提升推理和事实回忆，但在中期训练仅提升推理却减缓事实回忆。他们将这种阶段依赖性归因于教师在不同数据域上的置信度不对称性（教师对程序性数据更自信）以及学生早期获得低熵事实知识的演化状态。基于此，提出Switch Distillation：以教师预测熵作为轻量级路由信号，在教师高置信度的token上进行蒸馏，其余token回退到标准交叉熵损失。

Result: Switch Distillation在不同教师规模上一致优于现有蒸馏目标。相对标准NTP，推理性能提升1.61-1.71倍，知识与常识性能提升1.13-1.19倍，同时保留96.7-96.8%的事实回忆。在后训练之后这些收益仍然持续：弥补了事实回忆差距，同时维持推理性能1.25-1.32倍、知识与常识性能1.13-1.20倍的增益。

Conclusion: KD收益并非跨训练阶段一致，其效果受教师置信度与学生学习状态的交互影响。Switch Distillation通过熵感知的蒸馏路由机制，在中期训练阶段实现了推理、知识与事实回忆三者之间的更优平衡，且收益能贯穿至后训练阶段，是一种简单而有效的蒸馏训练目标。

Abstract: Logit-based knowledge distillation (KD) is used to train smaller language models (LMs) via supervision from stronger teachers, but whether its benefits are consistent across training stages remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we find that forward Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation--the standard KD formulation--with post-trained teachers behaves fundamentally differently during mid-training, an intermediate phase of self-supervised learning on curated corpora. Surprisingly, while forward KD simultaneously improves reasoning and factual recall during pre-training relative to standard next-token prediction (NTP), it instead slows factual recall acquisition during mid-training despite continued reasoning gains. We trace this stage dependence to an asymmetry in teacher confidence across data domains and the student's evolving knowledge state: teachers are more confident on procedural than knowledge-intensive data, while students acquire low-entropy factual knowledge earlier in training. To mitigate this imbalance, we propose Switch Distillation, a simple mid-training objective that distills on tokens where the teacher is confident, using teacher predictive entropy as a lightweight routing signal, and otherwise falls back to cross-entropy. Switch Distillation consistently outperforms existing distillation objectives across teacher sizes. Relative to standard NTP, it achieves 1.61-1.71x the reasoning performance and 1.13-1.19x the knowledge and commonsense performance while preserving 96.7-96.8% of factual recall. Crucially, these benefits persist after post-training: Switch Distillation closes the factual recall gap while maintaining 1.25-1.32x and 1.13-1.20x gains in reasoning and knowledge and commonsense, respectively.

</details>


### [234] [SDARE-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Conversational Stigma Detection and Response in Dyadic and Group Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01548)
*Stephanie Fong,Yiwen Jiang,Zimu Wang,Hongxi Yang,Yaling Shen,Hiu Weh Naomi Chow,Heung Ying Lai,Xiangyu Zhao,Qingyang Xu,Zhongxing Xu,Jiahe Liu,Guilherme C. Oliveira,Vincent Lee,Zongyuan Ge,Dominic Dwyer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SDARE-Bench，首个基于场景的基准测试，用于评估LLM在二元对话和群体对话中的污名检测与开放式回应生成能力，包含1,138个二元查询和1,388组群体对话。实验发现8个LLM在污名识别上表现不佳，尤其在群体对话中污名表达率显著升高（群体压力场景下平均高达97.5%），揭示了污名回应是LLM反复出现的安全漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地参与建议寻求和决策过程，可能影响社会判断，但针对污名（stigma）的基准测试仍然稀缺。现有通用评估依赖静态提示和固定格式任务，忽视了日常交流中的对话情境和受众效应。

Method: 构建SDARE-Bench基准，包含1,138个二元查询和1,388组群体对话；评估LLM的污名检测能力和开放式回应生成；使用在1,392条人类标注回应上训练的分类器对回应进行评价；同时构建群体压力场景进行测试。

Result: 8个LLM在污名识别上表现持续不佳，尤其在群体对话中；群体场景下污名表达比二元对话显著更高，对污名的抵抗更弱，建议更不切实际；在精心构造的群体压力场景中，污名表达率平均高达97.5%。

Conclusion: 污名回应是LLM反复出现的安全漏洞，尤其是在社会复杂的对话情境中，需要更关注对话上下文和群体效应下的安全评估。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in advice seeking and decision making that may affect social judgements. Despite stigma's profound effects on people and communities, benchmarks remain scarce. Existing general-domain evaluations typically rely on static prompts and fixed-format tasks, overlooking conversational contexts and audience effects in everyday communication. To address these gaps, we introduce SDARE-Bench, the first scenario-based benchmark evaluating both stigma detection and open-ended response generation in LLMs, comprising 1,138 dyadic queries and 1,388 group dialogue. Empirical results across 8 LLMs consistently demonstrate poor identification of stigma components, especially in group dialogues. In open-ended response generation, stigma expression was substantially higher in group settings than in dyadic, with weaker resistance to stigma and more unrealistic advice. Responses were evaluated using a classifier trained on 1,392 human annotated responses. In constructed group pressure settings, stigma expression rates further increased to a striking average of 97.5%. Our findings identify stigma response as a recurring LLM safety vulnerability, especially in socially complex conversational contexts.

</details>


### [235] [A systematic Approach to constructing a Chance-and-Risk Matrix for Semiconductor Supply Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01563)
*Ema Salkić,Alexander Fichtl,Philipp Ulrich,Hans Ehm,Marta Bonik,Georg Groh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个端到端的半导体供应链风险情报提取与排序管道，利用LLM从企业公开文件中提取风险和机会，构建知识图谱，并通过三层排序机制（算法公式、LLM相关性调整、专家验证）进行优先级排序。在五家企业的实验中生成76,207个评分条目，独立检验有效率达92.6%，自动化排序与专家判断的Spearman相关性分别达0.55（风险）和0.72（机会），识别出贸易限制是跨企业主导风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体供应链面临地缘政治紧张、地理集中和快速技术变革带来的风险日益升级，但现有系统缺乏可扩展的框架来持续从公开企业披露中提取、结构化并优先排序风险情报。

Method: 构建端到端管道：(1)检索半导体企业的公司文件；(2)使用LLM提取文件描述的风险和机会；(3)将信息组织成知识图谱，链接每个条目到其类别、来源和相关事件；(4)合并重复项；(5)通过三层机制排序——算法公式、LLM相关性调整、专家验证。

Result: 管道应用于价值链上五家企业，产出76,207个评分条目，独立检查发现92.6%有效；自动化排名与专家判断的平均Spearman相关性风险为0.55、机会为0.72；生成的风险矩阵识别出贸易限制是主导性跨企业风险。

Conclusion: 该管道展示了从公开企业披露中大规模、自动化提取和排序供应链风险情报的可行性，为半导体行业提供了可扩展的风险监测与优先排序方案。

Abstract: Semiconductor supply chains face escalating risks from geopolitical tensions, geographic concentration, and rapid technological shifts, yet no scalable system continuously extracts, structures, and prioritizes risk intelligence from public corporate disclosures. We present an end-to-end pipeline that retrieves corporate documents for semiconductor companies and uses large language models (LLMs) to extract the risks and opportunities they describe. It organizes these into a knowledge graph linking each item to its category, sources, and related events, then merges duplicates and ranks them with a three-layer mechanism combining an algorithmic formula, an LLM relevance adjustment, and expert validation. Applied to five companies across the value chain, the pipeline produces 76,207 scored items, of which an independent check finds 92.6% valid. The automated rankings match expert judgment at an average Spearman correlation of 0.55 for risks and 0.72 for opportunities, and the resulting matrices identify trade restrictions as the dominant cross-company risk.

</details>


### [236] [From Confusion to Clarity: Confusion-Aware Retrieval and Knowledge Injection for Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01564)
*Manish Gupta,Chaitanya Giri,Jayasimha Talur*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需微调的框架来解决LLM在语义相似标签的大规模分类任务中的困难。该框架通过(1)识别模型难以区分的标签对，(2)扩展候选集包含易混淆标签，(3)生成针对性区分规则三步来提升分类性能。在WOS、Flipkart、LEDGAR三个基准上，Macro F1比检索基线提升最多10.0个百分点，且生成的规则可迁移到更小的模型（2B-20B），带来最高11.5个百分点的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在将文本分类到具有大量语义相似标签的分类体系时表现不佳，因为这些标签间的区别是领域特定的，预训练阶段未捕获。常见的top-K检索方法虽然减少了候选数量，但当两个相似标签同时出现在候选中时，模型缺乏区分的信号，无法正确选择。

Method: 提出一个三步框架：(1)识别模型难以区分的标签对（confusable标签对）；(2)扩展候选集以包含这些易混淆标签，确保相似标签被纳入考量；(3)生成针对性规则来区分相似候选标签。整个框架无需微调。

Result: 在WOS、Flipkart、LEDGAR三个基准上，该方法相比检索基线Macro F1提升最多10.0个百分点。生成的规则可跨模型迁移至更小的模型（2B-20B），带来最高11.5个百分点的提升。

Conclusion: 通过识别易混淆标签对并生成区分规则，可以有效提升LLM在大规模语义相似标签分类任务上的表现，且无需微调，规则具有跨模型迁移能力，可惠及参数更小的模型。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) struggle to classify text into taxonomies with many semantically similar labels, as the distinctions are domain-specific and not captured by pre-training. To handle large label spaces, a common approach retrieves top-$K$ candidate labels by embedding similarity and prompt the LLM to choose among them. However, top-$K$ retrieval reduces the number of candidates but does not help the model tell similar ones apart. When two similar labels both appear as candidates, the model lacks the signal to choose correctly between them. We propose a framework that (1) identifies which label pairs the model struggles to distinguish, (2) expands the candidate set to include confusable labels, and (3) generates targeted rules to differentiate between similar candidates. The framework requires no fine-tuning, and the generated rules transfer to smaller, cheaper models. On three benchmarks (WOS, Flipkart, LEDGAR), our approach improves Macro F1 by up to 10.0pp over retrieval baselines, with smaller models (2B--20B) gaining up to 11.5pp via cross-model transfer.

</details>


### [237] [From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01572)
*Olga Tsymboi,Dmitrii Stoianov,Ramil Latypov,Danil Taranets,Daniil Dryabin,Mikhail Gashkov,Viktor Zelenkovskiy,Aleksandr Fida,Gleb Alektorov,Nikita Gulyakov,Arthur Babkin,Aleksandr Medvedev,Pavel Gein,Anatolii Potapov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种企业自托管LLM的模型整合方法：通过将200多个内部应用的流量整合到单一模型上，针对指令遵循、函数调用和内部任务分布三个维度分别训练GRPO专家，再通过两阶段SLERP合并，最终以远小于基线模型7倍参数量的规模在多项指标上超越基线，并承载了平台50%的流量（每月1.16亿请求）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驻留约束迫使企业自托管LLM，但持续采用新模型而不退役旧模型会导致服务集群碎片化，分割有限的GPU池。因此需要一种方法将流量整合到更少的模型上，同时保证质量不下降。

Method: 1) 通过生产错误分析沿三个维度（指令遵循、函数调用、内部任务分布）识别质量差距；2) 使用与生产流量分层的离线基准测试跟踪质量；3) 为每个维度单独训练GRPO专家而非联合优化（避免跨领域奖励干扰）；4) 通过两阶段SLERP合并专家；5) 针对每个专家暴露的不同失败模式（语义坍塌、过度调用、冗长作弊）进行领域特定修复。

Result: 在非推理模式下，该模型在内部Arena上以69.6对65.8超越总参数量约7倍大的基线，指令遵循0.85对0.83，函数调用0.79对0.77，同时提升了通用对话基准表现。模型以较小的服务成本承担了平台50%的流量（每月1.16亿请求）。

Conclusion: 通过分轴训练专家模型并合并，可以在显著缩小模型规模的同时保持甚至超越多模型集群的质量，实现GPU资源的高效利用和服务成本的大幅降低，为数据驻留约束下的企业LLM部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.

</details>


### [238] [Scaling Near-Optimal SFT-RL Annotation Budget Allocation from Small to Large LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01573)
*Jingtan Wang,Arun Verma,Xiaoqiang Lin,Zhengyuan Liu,Nancy F. Chen,Daniela Rus,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM后训练中如何在SFT和RL之间分配固定标注预算的问题。作者提出"近最优区域"框架，不追求单一最优分配比，而是刻画在特定性能容忍度内所有可接受的分配集合。实验发现该区域即使在很小的容忍度(2-10%)下也很宽，随模型规模增大而变宽，且能从小型代理模型可靠迁移到大型目标模型。这为实际策略提供了依据：用小模型实验即可识别可迁移的近最优区域，无需大规模穷举搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究仅描述SFT和RL数据分配的大致趋势（如低数据量下SFT占优），缺乏系统性的分配框架，也未考察最优分配比是否随模型规模迁移。这导致在固定标注预算下如何科学分配SFT与RL数据缺乏原则性指导。

Method: 将SFT-RL分配问题重新框架为"近最优性"问题：不寻找单一最优比例，而是定义近最优区域（在峰值性能的指定容忍度内的所有分配的集合）。通过实验系统评估该区域的宽度、随模型规模的变化趋势，以及能否从代理小模型迁移到目标大模型。同时分析SFT与RL数据标注成本不对称性对近最优区域位置的影响。

Result: 近最优区域即使在小容忍度(2-10%)下也很宽；该区域随模型规模增大而变宽；区域可靠地从代理小模型迁移到目标大模型。结果在多种任务、模型家族下一致，并适用于基于偏好的off-policy和基于奖励监督的on-policy两类RL方法。标注成本不对称性会改变近最优区域的位置。

Conclusion: 提出了一种实用的SFT-RL预算分配策略：利用小规模代理模型实验即可确定可迁移的近最优分配区域，从而避免在大模型上进行昂贵且耗时的穷举搜索。该发现为LLM后训练的预算分配提供了更具操作性的指导原则。

Abstract: How to divide a fixed annotation budget between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) during LLM post-training remains an open problem. Existing work characterizes only broad trends (e.g., SFT dominates in low-data regimes), lacks a principled allocation framework, and does not examine whether the optimal ratio transfers across model sizes. We frame this problem in terms of near-optimality: rather than seeking a single optimal SFT-RL ratio, we characterize the near-optimal region, the set of allocations within a specified tolerance of peak performance. Empirically, this region is wide even for small tolerances (2-10%), widens with model scale, and transfers reliably from small proxy models to large target models. This yields a practical strategy: small proxy-model experiments suffice to identify a transferable near-optimal region, eliminating the need for exhaustive large-scale search. Our results hold consistently across tasks, model families, and both preference-based off-policy and reward-supervision on-policy RL methods. We further analyze how the asymmetry in annotation costs between SFT and RL data shifts the near-optimal region.

</details>


### [239] [Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01575)
*Maksim Evdokimov,Matvey Ivanov,Dmitrii Tsiupin,Olga Tsymboi,Anatolii Potapov,Aleksandr Ivanov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个已部署的文档理解系统，基于MoE VLM（35B总参数、3B激活参数），在单块H100上运行，通过微调和难度感知的数据构建流程，在多类文档工作流上超越更大规模的基线模型，并将成本较人工标注降低80%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在受监管行业中，每年从数亿文档中提取结构化字段的成本仍然高昂：定制的OCR流程仅覆盖部分工作流，隐私规则禁止使用外部模型，而现有通过质量门槛的开源VLM其服务成本甚至高于人工标注。因此需要一种既满足隐私与质量要求又经济可行的文档理解方案。

Method: 构建基于Mixture-of-Experts VLM（35B总参数、3B激活参数）的部署系统；在内部生产数据与开放式文档混合数据上进行微调，采用难度感知（Difficulty-Aware）的数据构建流程，关注布局多样性、事实可提取性和跨模型一致性；通过提示（prompting）方式服务于异构工作流，且可在单块H100上运行。

Result: 该模型在所有可部署的（非推理型）基线中领先，包括比其大一个数量级的模型。基于生产遥测校准的质量调整成本分析显示，相较于人工基线成本降低超过80%，相较最佳竞品开源模型降低超过50%，而更大的基线模型在经济上不可行。

Conclusion: 通过高效的MoE架构配合精心设计的数据管线，可以在满足监管隐私要求与质量门槛的前提下，实现大规模文档理解任务的经济可行部署，大幅替代人工标注并优于现有开源方案。

Abstract: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation. We present a deployed document-understanding system built on a Mixture-of-Experts VLM (35B total, 3B active), fine-tuned on in-house production data mixed with open-domain documents curated by a Difficulty-Aware pipeline for layout diversity, fact-extractability, and cross-model consistency. Fitting on a single H100 and serving heterogeneous workflows via prompting, the model leads all deployable (non-reasoning) baselines up to an order of magnitude larger. A quality-adjusted cost analysis, with confirmation and correction costs calibrated from production telemetry, shows it reduces expected costs by over 80% against the human baseline and by more than 50% against the best competing open-source model, while larger baselines remain economically unviable.

</details>


### [240] [StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01591)
*Ke Yang,Chenglong Wang,Michel Galley,Chandan Singh,Jeevana Priya Inala,ChengXiang Zhai,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出StudentSim框架，通过池化训练加逐学生特化的方式，将稀疏的每学生数据转化为个性化学生模拟器，使其既能忠实模仿学生回应又能模拟学生接受导师指导后的变化。同时引入StudentSimEval标准化评估协议，覆盖象棋、英语二语写作和数学三个领域共60名学生，实验表明StudentSim在行为保真度和指导响应度两项指标上均优于GPT-5.4和Maia2，并作为奖励模型训练的象棋导师获得专家好评。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI导师需要针对每个学生的特点进行自适应指导，但收集真实学习者对不同指导方式的反应证据既稀少又缓慢且成本高昂。学生模拟器可作为代理信号，但现有方法存在局限：状态追踪模型能契合学生行为却不擅长处理解释或纠错，LLM角色扮演虽能流畅遵循指导却无法可靠匹配被模仿学生的实际能力水平。

Method: StudentSim采用两阶段训练框架：先在学生池上进行共享训练（捕获一般学习模式），再为每个学生进行个性化特化（适配个体差异）。同时提出StudentSimEval标准化评估协议，以行为保真度F和指导响应度R两个指标，在同一记录上对所有方法进行拟合与评估，覆盖象棋、英语二语写作和数学三个领域共60名学生。

Result: 在三个领域上StudentSim在F和R两个指标上均优于GPT-5.4。象棋领域StudentSim达到F=0.51、R=0.91，而GPT-5.4为0.23、0.72，Maia2为0.45、0.27。作为概念验证，以StudentSim作为奖励模型进行导师强化学习训练，所得到的象棋导师被人类专家评为比无RL基线和基于GPT-5.4模拟器奖励训练的导师更准确、指导更好且更个性化。

Conclusion: StudentSim通过"共享训练+个性化特化"的框架有效弥合了现有学生模拟器在行为拟合与指导响应之间的鸿沟，兼具高行为保真度和高指导响应度，并能作为可靠奖励模型支撑导师强化学习，展示了用个性化学生模拟器提升AI教学系统自适应能力的可行性。代码已开源。

Abstract: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. Across all three domains, StudentSim outperforms GPT-5.4 on both metrics. In chess, StudentSim reaches F=0.51 and R=0.91, compared with 0.23 and 0.72 for GPT-5.4 and 0.45 and 0.27 for Maia2. As a proof of concept, using StudentSim as a reward model for tutor reinforcement learning produces a chess tutor that expert humans rate as more accurate, better-guided, and more personalized than a no-RL baseline and a tutor trained against a GPT-5.4 simulator reward. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim.

</details>


### [241] [The Rise of Verbal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01597)
*Kshitij Tayal,Arun Sharma,Genta Indra Winata,Anirban Das,Sambit Sahu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次对"语言强化学习"(Verbal Reinforcement Learning, VRL)这一新兴范式进行了统一综述，将其组织为三个支柱：语言作为基础信号、语言作为深思熟虑的反馈、语言作为学习信号，系统梳理了该领域的研究现状与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言正成为改进语言智能体的主要反馈渠道，能够以人类和语言模型都能理解的形式传达意图、偏好和因果结构。然而该领域缺乏统一的框架来组织和理解众多相关工作，需要一个系统的分类体系来整合分散的研究成果。

Method: 作者提出一个统一轴来组织该领域：语言反馈在智能体生命周期中何时生效以及修改什么，由此得出三大支柱分类法：(1)语言作为基础信号——语言定义任务本身（目标、状态、奖励结构）；(2)语言作为深思熟虑反馈——在测试时引导推理而不更新模型参数；(3)语言作为学习信号——通过语言反馈在训练中塑造模型参数。在每个支柱内，作者综合代表性工作、区分关键子类别，并概述语言在塑造智能体行为中的独特作用。

Result: 该分类法展示了语言强化反馈如何重塑智能体开发，阐明了三个支柱各自的代表性工作、关键子类别及语言发挥的不同作用，同时界定了构建更强大且更对齐的智能体所面临的挑战与机遇。

Conclusion: 语言强化学习正成为智能体开发领域的重要范式转变，该统一的分类框架有助于理解这一领域的全貌，并为未来在构建更强大、更对齐的智能体方面指明了研究方向与待解决的挑战。

Abstract: Natural language is emerging as a primary feedback channel for improving language agents, capable of conveying intent, preferences, and causal structure in forms interpretable by both humans and modern language models. We call this paradigm Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL) and offer the first unified account of it. We organize the field around a single axis, \textit{when} verbal feedback takes effect in an agent's lifecycle and \textit{what} it modifies, yielding three pillars: (1) \textbf{Language as Grounding Signal}, where language defines the task itself by specifying goals, states, and reward structures; (2) \textbf{Language as Deliberative Feedback}, where natural language guides reasoning at test time without the need to update model parameters; (3) \textbf{Language as Learning Signal}, where language-based feedback shapes model parameters through training. Within each pillar, we synthesize representative work, distinguish key subcategories of approaches, and outline the distinct role language plays in shaping agent behavior. Together, this taxonomy shows how verbal reinforcement is reshaping agent development, while also defining the challenges and opportunities for building more capable and aligned agents.

</details>


### [242] [CordisBench: Can Language Models Reason About Component Lifecycles in Dynamic Agent Harnesses?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01600)
*Damien Sileo,Dimitri Kachler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CordisBench是一个包含1200个问题的基准测试，用于评估语言模型在动态agent环境中对组件生命周期（依赖关系和清理传播）进行推理的能力，测试发现模型在小规模系统上表现良好，但随着交互数量增加可靠性下降，且额外推理努力虽能改善某些模型的性能但成本高昂。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态agent工具允许语言模型修改塑造自身执行的软件，这种灵活性带来了新的推理负担——局部插件更改可能通过依赖关系和清理传播影响整个系统，现有基准缺乏对此类生命周期推理的系统评估。

Method: 构建CordisBench，结合受控形式化设置与在Cordis运行时（管理组件依赖和清理）上执行的程序，包含识别受影响组件、预测拆卸顺序后的状态、判断条件成立性、选择可成功执行的重新配置等任务。评估三个面向效率的模型在不同推理努力级别和不同相关交互数量（2-32）下的表现，使用确定性任务特定评分，并与独立的有限参考语义进行一致性验证。

Result: 模型在小规模系统上通常表现良好，但随着更多交互变得相关时可靠性下降，尤其在预测最终状态和跨拆卸顺序推理时。额外的推理努力为某些模型带来显著性能提升。在16交互子集上，GPT-5.6 Luna在中等努力下每个问题使用近3000个推理token。独立的有限参考语义在所有528个可执行问题的评分观察和行动结果上与Cordis执行完全一致，表明额外成本是可避免的。

Conclusion: CordisBench量化了动态agent生命周期推理的挑战，揭示了模型在交互规模扩大时的可靠性瓶颈，并证明由于存在可用的确定性参考语义，模型在此类受控实例上产生的推理成本本质上是可避免的，暗示可以通过更高效的方法替代昂贵的推理策略。

Abstract: Dynamic agent harnesses let language models change the software that shapes their own execution. This flexibility brings a new reasoning burden: a local plugin change can propagate through dependencies and cleanup. We introduce CordisBench, a 1,200-question benchmark of this lifecycle reasoning. It combines a controlled formal setting with programs executed against Cordis, a runtime that manages component dependencies and cleanup, and asks models to identify affected components, predict state after a specified teardown order, determine which conditions hold under all or some orders, and choose reconfigurations that succeed when executed. Across these tasks, we evaluate three efficiency-oriented models at low reasoning effort with 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, or 32 relevant interactions, using deterministic task-specific scoring. Models usually handle small systems well but grow less reliable as more interactions become relevant, especially when predicting final state and when reasoning across teardown orders. Additional inference effort recovers marked gains for some models. The cost is nontrivial: on our 16-interaction subset, GPT-5.6 Luna uses nearly 3,000 reasoning tokens per question at medium effort. For these controlled instances, that cost is avoidable: an independent finite reference semantics agrees with Cordis execution on every observation and action outcome used for scoring across all 528 executable questions.

</details>


### [243] [Beyond Scores: Understanding LLM-as-a-Judge Mechanisms in Summarization Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01604)
*Himil Vasava,Ming Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过机制可解释性方法，研究了基于LLM的NLG质量评估器（如Themis和Prometheus）内部如何分配评分。研究发现它们采用两阶段结构化评估流程：浅层（<15层）注意力进行局部错误比较并路由信息，深层MLP级联整合信号并写出评分，且评分决策在特定深层（Themis L=26，Prometheus L=25）的残差流中结晶。与同规模基座模型对比，隔离出微调安装的两种机制（抑制浅层MLP贡献和结晶深度前移两层），表明微调是在重塑已有基底而非从零构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM评估器被广泛用作打分工具和自动训练信号，但其内部评分机制仍鲜为人知，理解这一过程对于提升评估器的可靠性和可解释性至关重要。

Method: 采用八种攻击的扰动分类法（覆盖NLG质量的可读性和充分性两个维度），构建生成流水线产生成对的干净与损坏摘要（带受控错误强度和显式token级修改映射），并运用四项实验：因果追踪、logit-lens词汇投影、注意力头敲除，应用于Themis (Llama-3-8B)和Prometheus (Mistral-7B)，并与同规模基座控制模型对比。

Result: 两个评估器均实现了两阶段的结构化评估流水线：第15层以下注意力负责局部错误比较并将结果路由到最终输入位置；第15层以上MLP级联整合信号并写出评分，决策在尖锐的深层（Themis L=26，Prometheus L=25）残差流中结晶。基座模型对照复现了路由架构和结晶现象，但不具阶段分离，隔离出微调安装的两种机制。

Conclusion: 微调通过两种特定机制（抑制最后位置浅层MLP贡献、结晶深度前移两层）重新塑造现有架构基底来安装评估流水线，而非从头构建。研究发布了源代码和数据供进一步研究。

Abstract: LLM-based evaluators of natural language generation (NLG) quality are widely deployed as scoring tools and as automated training signals, yet the internal procedure by which they assign a rating remains poorly understood. We investigate this procedure mechanistically through an eight-attack perturbation taxonomy across the Readability and Adequacy dimensions of NLG quality, a generation pipeline that produces paired clean and corrupt summaries with controlled error intensity and explicit token-level modification maps, and a four-experiment battery of causal tracing, logit-lens vocabulary projection, and attention-head knockout applied to Themis (Llama-3-8B) and Prometheus (Mistral-7B). Both evaluators implement a structured, coherent evaluation pipeline operating in two stages: below layer 15, attention performs local error comparison and routes the result to the final input position; above it, the MLP cascade integrates the signal and writes the rating, with the decision crystallizing in the residual stream at a sharp late layer (L = 26 on Themis, L = 25 on Prometheus). Furthermore, a base-model control at the same scale (Llama-3-8B) reproduces the routing architecture and crystallization but not the stage separation, isolating the two mechanisms that fine-tuning specifically installs, suppression of below-L15 MLP contribution at the last position and a two-layer advance of the crystallization depth, indicating that fine-tuning sculpts an existing substrate rather than building the pipeline from scratch. We release the source code and data at https://github.com/himil-v/judge-mech

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [244] [Task-Specific Prompt with Global Context for Multi-Task Graph Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00047)
*Zhiyang Qiu,Yangtao Wang,Xiaocui Li,Yanzhao Xie,Siyuan Chen,Wensheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TPGC是一种双先验提示初始化方法，通过任务先验注入模块（短时同源多任务预训练继承优化偏好）和结构先验注入模块（提取全局结构上下文生成层级提示向量），解决多任务图预训练中随机初始化提示导致的提示空间、预文本目标与图结构特征对齐不佳的问题，在6个基准的少样本节点/图分类任务上优于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图提示学习框架在多任务预训练下使用随机初始化提示，导致提示空间、预文本目标与图结构特性之间缺乏良好对齐，严重削弱了提示表征的任务相关性、结构感知性与可迁移性。

Method: 提出双先验提示初始化方案TPGC：(1)Task-Prior Injection Module在辅助图上进行短时同源多任务预训练，使提示继承多预文本任务的优化偏好；(2)Structure-Prior Injection Module在任务感知表征基础上提取可迁移的全局结构上下文，通过聚合结构信息丰富的节点嵌入转换为逐层提示向量。

Result: 在6个涵盖节点与图分类的主流基准上，少样本设置下TPGC一致优于SOTA基线，且下游可调参数更少、运行时间更低。

Conclusion: TPGC通过显式建模任务先验与结构先验的协同作用，验证了先验告知的提示初始化能有效提升图提示学习的对齐质量与少样本泛化性能。

Abstract: Graph prompt learning is an effective paradigm to adapt pre-trained graph models to downstream tasks in low-resource scenarios. However, existing multi-task graph pre-training frameworks generally use randomly initialized prompts, leading to poor alignment between the prompt space, pretext objectives and graph structural characteristics. This greatly weakens the task relevance, structural awareness and transferability of prompt representations. To address this challenge, we propose TPGC, a dual-prior prompt initialization solution that explicitly models the synergy between task prior and structural prior. Specifically, the Task-Prior Injection Module first conducts a short homologous multi-task pre-training on an auxiliary graph, enabling prompt initialization to inherit optimization preferences associated with multiple pretext tasks. Built on the task-aware representations, the Structure-Prior Injection Module further extracts transferable global structural context from the auxiliary graph, converting it into layer-wise prompt vectors by aggregating structurally informative node embeddings. Extensive experiments on 6 mainstream benchmarks covering node and graph classification show that TPGC achieves consistently better performance under few-shot settings than state-of-the-art baselines, with fewer downstream tunable parameters and lower runtime. The code is available at https://github.com/Virgilqiu/TPGC

</details>


### [245] [REAL-Q: E2E LLM Quantization via Dynamic Gradient Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00049)
*Qian Zhang,Yaoming Li,Zhewen Tan,Yanshu Wang,Heng Lu,Kun Su,Zongwei Lv,Wenhan Yu,Yongge Ma,Yinjun Han,Ruikuang Liu,Tong Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: REAL-Q是一种新型的后训练量化(PTQ)范式，通过端到端对齐的全局损失代理函数配合细粒度、动态的逐列块梯度下降（每128列应用一次），并引入滑动窗口机制缓解跨层误差传播，在LLaMA-3.1和Qwen3系列模型上实现W4A16量化，端到端KL散度相比最先进的全局引导方法最高降低约49%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最先进的PTQ方法存在两个核心问题：(1) 为保持解析可行性，严重近似全局损失（丢弃跨通道耦合、将输出行分组），导致信息丢失；(2) Hessian矩阵在整层中冻结，无法随损失景观逐列变化而更新，造成"信息错配"（information misalignment）。

Method: REAL-Q放弃纯解析求解路线，采用端到端对齐的全局损失代理目标，通过细粒度动态块级梯度下降（每128列一个块）进行优化，并引入滑动窗口机制实现平滑的跨层过渡，从而缓解网络中的误差传播。

Result: 在LLaMA-3.1（8B和70B）和Qwen3（0.6B-32B）上以W4A16配置进行评估，端到端KL散度相对最先进的全局引导方法最高降低约49%。

Conclusion: REAL-Q通过动态细粒度优化取代静态近似求解，有效解决了PTQ中的信息错配问题，证明了打破"解析可解性"妥协范式可以带来显著的量化精度提升。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for deploying large language models (LLMs) under strict resource constraints. State-of-the-art PTQ methods quantize each layer with a single closed-form second-order solver: to remain analytically tractable, they heavily approximate the global loss (dropping cross-channel coupling, pooling output rows into groups), and they then freeze the resulting Hessian across the entire layer, with no way to refresh it as the loss landscape shifts column by column--a phenomenon we call information misalignment. We propose REAL-Q (Real-time E2E-loss Aligned LLM Quantization), a novel PTQ paradigm that breaks this compromise: instead of diluting the objective for the sake of analytic tractability, REAL-Q targets an end-to-end-aligned surrogate of the global loss and refines it via fine-grained, dynamic Block-wise Gradient Descent applied after every column block (128 columns). By coupling this fine-grained correction with a sliding window mechanism for smooth cross-layer transitions, REAL-Q effectively mitigates error propagation across the network. On LLaMA-3.1 (8B and 70B) and Qwen3 (0.6B-32B) at W4A16, REAL-Q reduces end-to-end KL divergence by up to ~49% relative to state-of-the-art globally-guided methods.

</details>


### [246] [Convergence issues in Relational Concept Analysis based on AOC-posets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00054)
*Xavier Dolques,Agnès Braud,Alain Gutierrez,Marianne Huchard,Florence Le Ber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文深入研究了基于AOC-poset（仅由引入对象或属性的概念组成的简化概念格结构）的关系概念分析（RCA）中的收敛性问题。研究表明，在基于完整概念格的经典RCA中收敛性有保证，但切换到AOC-poset后这一保证丧失。作者分析了收敛性丧失的原因，识别了可以保持收敛的条件，讨论了通过数据变换恢复收敛的方法，并提出了一种保持AOC-poset结构的收敛变体——通过永不移除已创建的关系属性来保证收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式概念分析（FCA）扩展为关系概念分析（RCA）以处理多关系数据，通常基于完整概念格。然而在应用中，AOC-poset等概念格子结构因规模更小、计算更易而更受青睐。虽然RCA可以基于AOC-poset实例化，但在此设定下RCA的收敛性保证会丧失，这一点此前未被深入探讨。理解并解决这一收敛性问题对于AOC-poset在实际应用中的可靠使用至关重要。

Method: 作者首先分析了在AOC-poset设定下RCA迭代过程收敛性丧失的根本原因，指出当迭代过程中仅有部分概念（引入对象或属性的概念）被保留时，关系属性的引入与移除可能导致迭代无法达到不动点。然后作者识别了保证收敛的特定条件，并讨论了通过数据变换（如调整数据表示方式）来恢复收敛的可能路径。最后提出一种收敛变体方案：一旦关系属性被创建就不再移除，以此确保过程收敛，代价是某些关系属性可能引用最终结构中不存在（缺失）的概念。

Result: 论文揭示了AOC-poset设定下RCA收敛性丧失的机制，给出了收敛性可以保持的条件刻画，提供了通过数据集变换恢复收敛的策略，并提出了一种实用的收敛变体——关系属性只增不减的策略确保收敛，尽管可能产生引用最终结构中不存在概念的关系属性。

Conclusion: 基于AOC-poset的RCA虽然在计算复杂性上优于基于完整概念格的RCA，但其收敛性需要额外关注。本文为这一理论问题提供了系统分析，既给出了理论上可保证收敛的条件，也提出了实用的收敛变体方案，为AOC-poset在关系数据概念分析中的实际应用奠定了更坚实的理论基础。

Abstract: Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) is an approach for conceptual classification building and rule discovery from a binary table describing a set of objects by a set of attributes. Extensions have been proposed to deal with non-binary and more complex data, such as Relational Concept Analysis (RCA) for multi-relational data. RCA aims to highlight groups of objects characterized by their relationships with other groups of objects. The richer and more complex nature of the underlying data allows RCA to produce richer results than FCA, at the expense of higher computational and interpretive complexity. The most commonly used conceptual classification structure in FCA is the concept lattice. However, in many applications, concept lattice substructures, such as AOC-posets, are preferred over the full lattice, either to mitigate combinatorial blow-up or to focus on the most informative parts of the structure. Indeed, in an AOC-poset, only concepts introducing an object or an attribute are represented, which makes AOC-posets smaller and easier to compute and use than concept lattices. Although RCA was originally defined on concept lattices, it can also be instantiated on AOC-posets. RCA is iterative and its convergence is guaranteed in the lattice-based setting, but this guarantee is lost when using AOC-posets. In this paper, we investigate this loss of convergence in detail. We show why convergence is no longer guaranteed in the general case, identify conditions under which it can still be ensured, and discuss how a dataset can be transformed to recover convergence. We also propose a convergent variant of the process, which preserves the AOC-poset structure: relational attributes, once created, are never removed, which guarantees convergence at the price of attributes that may refer to concepts absent from the final structures.

</details>


### [247] [DISTAL: Distillation and Self-Supervised Pretraining for Structure-Agnostic Materials Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00059)
*Weiran Wang,Xintong Huo,Yueying Wang,Yusi Fan,Wenyan Wang,Xin Feng,Ruihao Xin,Lan Huang,Kewei Li,Fengfeng Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DISTAL框架，用于材料性能预测。它结合自监督成分预训练与结构感知知识蒸馏，在训练时利用结构先验信息，但推理时仅需成分信息即可预测。在39个基准任务中有37个优于参考基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料性能预测在小数据场景下仍然困难，许多目标属性只有少量标注样本。现有的高精度模型依赖晶体结构信息，限制了其在早期筛选阶段（结构信息稀缺或不可用时）的应用。因此需要一种不依赖结构的预测方法，同时能利用已有的结构知识来提升性能。

Method: DISTAL采用双先验框架：(1) 利用145个成分描述符在大规模虚拟成分空间上进行自监督成分预训练，学习可迁移的成分表征；(2) 将预训练ALIGNN教师模型的结构知识蒸馏到成分条件的学生模型中，使训练阶段能利用结构信息而推理阶段不需要结构输入。最终统一预测管道整合了显式成分描述符、预训练潜在特征和蒸馏结构特征三种信号。

Result: 在39个基准任务上，最佳多模态配置融合了三种信号，其中有37个任务优于参考基准。DISTAL在所有评估的特征组合中取得最强的整体性能。

Conclusion: 成分预训练与结构蒸馏提供了互补的先验信息，为小数据材料信息学中的纯成分预测提供了一条实用且稳健的技术路线。

Abstract: Materials property prediction remains difficult in low-data settings, where many target properties are supported by only a limited number of labeled samples. Models with the strongest predictive accuracy often depend on crystal structures, which restricts their use in early-stage screening when structural information is limited or unavailable. To address this challenge, we propose DISTAL, a dual-prior framework for structure-agnostic materials property prediction that combines self-supervised compositional pretraining with structure-aware knowledge distillation. DISTAL first learns transferable compositional representations from a large virtual composition space using 145 composition-derived descriptors. It then distills structural knowledge from a pretrained ALIGNN teacher into a composition-conditioned student. This setting allows structural priors to be used during training without requiring structural inputs at inference. By integrating explicit compositional descriptors, pretrained latent features, and distilled structural features within a unified prediction pipeline, DISTAL captures complementary signals that are difficult to recover from any single representation alone. Across 39 benchmark tasks, the best-performing multimodal configuration combines all three signals, and improves over the reference benchmark on 37 tasks. DISTAL achieves the strongest overall performance among all evaluated feature combinations. These results indicate that compositional pretraining and structural distillation provide complementary priors and offer a practical route to robust composition-only prediction in small-data materials informatics. The source code and the pre-trained models are anonymously available at: https://osf.io/eq96d/overview?view_only=451617f42f7849e08750bd1852b48980 and will be released at the official link after acceptance.

</details>


### [248] [ReNFT: Repairing Mode Collapse in Reward Post-Training via Internal Probability-Mass Recalibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00061)
*Yuchen Bao,Chao Wen,Haowei Wang,Ruoxin Chen,Donghao Luo,Jiahui Zhan,Wenjian Huang,Shen Chen,Yiting Wang,Taiping Yao,Chengjie Wang,Shouhong Ding,Jianguo Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReNFT方法，通过内部概率质量再校准来修复已经发生模式坍塌但仍保持高奖励的扩散生成器适配器，无需外部信号即可恢复生成多样性，同时保留已获得的奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励后训练会导致扩散生成器出现模式坍塌，将概率质量集中在少数奖励偏好的模式上，消除提示间的多样性。现有缓解方法依赖外部信号或接口（如感知目标增强奖励、调整参考正则化、修改文本编码器），但无法修复已经坍塌的适配器，同时保留已获得的奖励。作者观察到在线后训练主要是在预训练继承的能力间重新分配概率质量，因此坍塌是抑制而非删除，可以从生成器内部逆转。

Method: ReNFT通过内部概率质量再校准来修复高奖励、低多样性的适配器。具体包括：(1) 使用无条件探针优先选择"反枢纽"提示，这些提示最容易暴露与提示无关的偏差；(2) 两条策略主导的混合路径从相同提示和初始噪声生成匹配的反事实建议——一条探测冻结的基础方向以寻找被抑制的替代方案，另一条暴露后训练的无条件倾向；(3) 采用带自适应翻转守卫的奖励排序分配"推"和"拉"角色；(4) 联合配对NFT更新实现修复。

Result: 在PickScore和GenEval基准上，ReNFT分别保留NFT奖励的98.9%和99.0%，同时将DreamSim-Div多样性分别提升58.8%和55.0%，为外部干预提供了互补的替代方案。

Conclusion: ReNFT证明扩散生成器的坍塌是可逆的，可以通过纯内部的概率质量再校准来实现修复，在几乎不损失后训练奖励的情况下显著恢复生成多样性，为奖励后训练中的模式坍塌问题提供了一种无需外部干预的补充方案。

Abstract: Reward post-training of diffusion generators inevitably concentrates probability mass on a few reward-favored modes, a mode collapse that erases within-prompt diversity. Existing methods for mitigating collapse rely on external signals or interfaces, augmenting the reward with perceptual objectives, adjusting reference regularization, or modifying the text encoder, but none repairs an adapter that has already collapsed while preserving the acquired reward. We observe that online post-training primarily reallocates probability mass over capabilities inherited from pretraining rather than learning new visual content. Collapse is therefore suppression, not deletion, and can be reversed from within the generator. We propose ReNFT, which repairs a high-reward, low-diversity adapter through internal probability-mass recalibration. Unconditional probes first prioritize "anti-hub" prompts where the prompt-independent bias is easiest to expose. Two policy-dominated mixed routes then generate matched counterfactual proposals from the same prompt and initial noise, one probing the frozen base direction for suppressed alternatives and the other exposing the post-trained unconditional tendency. Reward ranking with an adaptive flipping guard assigns pull and push roles, and a joint-and-paired NFT update realizes the repair. On PickScore and GenEval, ReNFT retains 98.9% and 99.0% of NFT's reward while improving DreamSim-Div by 58.8% and 55.0%, respectively, offering a complementary alternative to external interventions.

</details>


### [249] [Attention Sensitivity Is Not Enough: Dissociating Attention-Level and Behavioural In-Context Learning under Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00064)
*Jinyuan Zhang,Peng He,He Hu,Yin Yuan,ShengShuo Jiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究注意力层面的上下文学习（ICL）代理指标在被优化后是否仍然可信。作者形式化了ICS（上下文敏感性）和ICL-GAP（行为准确率差距），在Llama-2-7B上通过四臂消融实验发现，最大化ICS的正则化器确实能将ICS推向几何上限，但行为读数显示ICL-GAP接近零且MMLU准确率大幅下降，形成Goodhart解离现象——有界注意力代理被"攻破"。机制定位表明注意力变得尖锐且跨前缀近乎不相交，却路由到格式化和演示本体token而非标签。作者进一步提出行为门控部分缓解该效应，而锚定预训练计算的目标能保持高MMLU、中等ICS的区域。核心教训：注意力级ICL代理只有在针对行为差距验证后才适合作为训练目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文学习使大语言模型能从演示中适应新任务，但微调可能侵蚀这种能力。现有保留诊断多检查注意力变化作为上下文敏感性的代理指标，但该代理被优化后能被信任到什么程度、是否会失效，缺乏系统研究。这是典型的Goodhart定律风险场景——当代理指标成为优化目标后，其与被预测对象之间的关系可能瓦解。

Method: 1) 形式化ICS（不一致前缀间最后token注意力的平均行距离）与ICL-GAP（行为准确率差距）；2) 在Llama-2-7B上设计四臂消融实验；3) 使用最大化ICS的KL正则化器（armKL）驱动ICS至接近几何上限；4) 通过端点统计定位机制（token级注意力路由分析）；5) 使用随机标签协议检验行为探针家族的动态范围；6) 进行构造性扫描比较行为门控与锚定预训练计算的目标。

Result: armKL正则化器将ICS推至1.413（距几何上限仅差0.5%），但ICL-GAP保持接近零，MMLU准确率从0.371降至0.279，出现Goodhart解离。机制上，注意力变得尖锐且跨前缀近乎不相交，但路由到格式化和演示本体token而非标签。随机标签协议表明行为探针仍保有动态范围。行为门控可部分缓解，锚定预训练计算的目标能保持高MMLU和中度ICS。

Conclusion: 注意力级ICL代理指标存在可靠性与优化脆弱性问题：即便ICS被推向几何上限，也不保证行为层面的ICL能力保留。核心教训是注意力代理只有在针对行为差距交叉验证之后才能作为训练目标使用，否则会陷入Goodhart解离陷阱。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) lets large language models adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, and fine-tuning can erode this behaviour. Many preservation diagnostics inspect attention: if attention changes when demonstrations change, the model is treated as context-sensitive. This paper asks how far that proxy can be trusted once it is optimised. We formalise \emph{In-Context Sensitivity} (ICS), the average row distance between last-token attention on matched and mismatched demonstration prefixes, and pair it with \emph{ICL-GAP}, the behavioural accuracy gap between the same prefixes. In a controlled four-arm ablation on Llama-2-7B, an ICS-maximising regulariser ($\armKL$) drives ICS to $1.413$, within $0.5\%$ of its geometric ceiling. The behavioural readout tells a different story: ICL-GAP stays near zero and MMLU accuracy moves from $0.371$ to $0.279$, a Goodhart dissociation of the bounded attention proxy. Endpoint statistics locate the mechanism: attention grows sharp and near-disjoint across prefixes yet routes to formatting and demonstration-body tokens rather than labels. A random-label protocol confirms that the behavioural probe family retains dynamic range at the same checkpoints. In a constructive sweep, behaviour gating partially mitigates the effect, while objectives anchored to pretrained computation hold the high-MMLU, moderate-ICS region that divergence maximisers leave. The main lesson is diagnostic: attention-level ICL proxies earn their place as training targets only after validation against behavioural gaps.

</details>


### [250] [Flawed in Nature, Perfect through Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00129)
*J. M. Diederik Kruijssen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"天生缺陷，进化完美"(Flawed-in-Nature)机制：通过对AI/ML模型的系数施加刻意突变，维持模型群体的多样性，使其在非平稳（漂移）环境中可持续地提升集体性能。该机制将集体性能提升建立在个体性能牺牲的基础上，并通过四个定理证明其遗憾（regret）缩减在有一般条件下有保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI/ML模型在训练分布发生漂移时性能会退化，这是现实世界问题的普遍特征。虽然已有方法将自然选择引入AI/ML，但优化过程天然趋向收敛，难以维持模型多样性，导致在动态环境中缺乏适应性。

Method: 1）提出Flawed-in-Nature机制：对模型群体施加偏离最优的刻意突变以维持多样性，作为应对非平稳性的统计对冲；2）通过四个定理从理论上证明该机制在一般条件下保证遗憾缩减；3）在合成线性回归任务上验证，并比较突变漂移率与环境漂移率的匹配效应；4）设计一个自适应控制器，自动调节突变漂移率以匹配未知的环境漂移率。

Result: 突变群体在约80%的环境变化中能提供最佳模型；推理综合（inference synthesis）成功将个体优势转化为集体优势；该机制在突变漂移率与环境漂移率匹配时最有效。

Conclusion: Flawed-in-Nature机制可作为一种通用的AI/ML系统设计原则，且其与生物进化的密切类比暗示这可能是实现更接近生物智能的AI形态所缺失的关键要素。

Abstract: The performance of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) models degrades when the problem they were trained on drifts. This is a near-universal feature of real-world problems, which often change unpredictably. Biological evolution has achieved intelligence by overcoming this obstacle through natural selection acting on heritable variation. AI/ML techniques have long incorporated forms of natural selection, but it has been challenging to maintain model diversity as optimization naturally drives convergence. Here we show that a swarm of AI/ML models subjected to deliberate mutations of their model coefficients away from optimality can reliably and sustainably improve performance in changing environments by acting as a statistical hedge against non-stationarity. We call this mechanism 'Flawed in Nature, Perfect through Evolution', reflecting that the collective performance gain goes at the expense of individual performance. We prove via four theorems that the resulting regret reduction is guaranteed under general conditions, establishing the Flawed-in-Nature mechanism as a generalizable design principle for AI/ML systems. We validate these results on synthetic linear regression tasks, demonstrating that the mutated swarm delivers the best model in $\sim80\%$ of environment changes and that inference synthesis successfully translates this individual advantage into a collective one. The mechanism proves to be most effective when the mutation drift rate matches the drift rate of the environment. We outline a simple, adaptive controller that enables practical applications by tuning the mutation drift rate to match the unknown drift rate of the environment. The close analogy of the Flawed-in-Nature mechanism to biological evolution suggests it may have been a critical missing ingredient for the organic discovery of AI forms that more closely mimic biological intelligence.

</details>


### [251] [RW-LoRA: Communication-Efficient Decentralized LoRA Fine-Tuning via Random Walks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00078)
*Xingran Chen,Rohit Bhagat,Ghadir Ayache,Rawad Bitar,Yanmin Gong,Salim El Rouayheb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于随机游走的LoRA微调方案，与传统分布式LoRA依赖集中聚合或八卦式（gossip）去中心化同步不同，该方法让单一模型token在网络中遍历并利用本地微调目标顺序更新，消除了全局同步需求，大幅降低通信和计算开销，并避免聚合误差。作者提供了非凸目标下的严格收敛保证，并在多种NLP任务和图拓扑上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分布式LoRA方法存在两大问题：集中式聚合方法依赖中心节点造成通信瓶颈，而gossip式去中心化LoRA需要多份模型副本反复同步，两者都产生显著通信开销，且多模型更新同时聚合会引入误差。

Method: 提出随机游走（random-walk）式LoRA微调方案：不维护多个模型副本，而是让单个模型token在网络节点间遍历，在每个节点上使用本地微调目标进行顺序更新，从而消除全局同步需求、降低通信与计算成本并避免聚合误差，同时提供了非凸目标下的理论收敛保证。

Result: 在多个NLP任务和图拓扑的实证实验中，所提方法与gossip式LoRA相比，在保持有竞争力的任务性能的同时，显著减少了通信和计算开销。

Conclusion: 随机游走式LoRA为分布式参数高效微调提供了一种新的思路，以顺序更新替代并行同步，在保证收敛性的前提下实现了更低的通信与计算成本，展示了去中心化微调的新可能性。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA have become a standard approach for adapting large foundation models. Adopting fine-tuning to distributed settings faces several challenges. Most existing distributed LoRA methods rely on centralized aggregation, and gossip-based decentralized LoRA requires repeated synchronization among multiple model copies. Both methods incur significant communication overhead and introduce errors due to simultaneous aggregation of multiple model updates. In this paper, we take a different perspective and propose a random-walk-based LoRA fine-tuning scheme. Instead of maintaining multiple model replicas, a single model token traverses the network and is updated sequentially using local fine-tuning objectives. This design eliminates the need for global synchronization, substantially reduces communication and computation costs, and avoids aggregation errors. We provide rigorous convergence guarantees for non-convex objectives under standard assumptions. Through empirical results on multiple NLP tasks and graph topologies, we show that the proposed method achieves competitive task performance with substantially less communication and computation than gossip-based LoRA.

</details>


### [252] [Stochastic complexity of vectors containing cluster structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00084)
*Daniel Nicorici,Olli Yli-Harja,Jaakko Astola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于归一化最大似然（NML）模型计算包含聚类结构的编码向量的随机概率（最短编码长度）问题，提出一种递归公式来高效计算归一化常数，将时间复杂度从多项式降低到线性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于最小描述长度（MDL）原理的数据聚类中（如估计最佳聚类数和最佳聚类结构），需要计算包含聚类结构的向量最短编码长度，而基于NML模型的直接计算需要关于向量大小和聚类数的多项式时间，效率较低。

Method: 引入递归公式来高效计算NML模型中的归一化常数，实现了对最短编码长度的线性时间复杂度计算，取代了以往的多项式时间复杂度方法。

Result: 新提出的递归公式在时间复杂度上具有线性复杂度，相较于此前的多项式复杂度有显著改进，证明了该问题是可处理的（tractable）。

Conclusion: 该工作使得基于MDL原则的聚类分析（如确定最佳聚类数）在计算上更加高效可行，为聚类结构的随机编码长度计算提供了线性时间解决方案。

Abstract: This paper studies the problem of computing the stochastic probability (shortest code length) of the encoded vectors containing cluster structure using Normalized Maximum Likelihood (NML) model. This is of great theoretical and practical importance in data clustering based on Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle, such as for estimating the best number of clusters and best cluster structure for the data. Straightforward computation of the shortest code length of the vector containing cluster structure based on the NML model requires polynomial time with respect to the size of the vector and number of clusters. We show that this is a tractable problem by introducing a recursion formula for the efficient computation of normalizing constant from the NML model. The time complexity of the new formula is linear opposed to previous polynomial time with respect to the size of the vector and number of clusters.

</details>


### [253] [GeoPAR: Large-Scale Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization with Geometry-Guided Parallel Autoregressive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00577)
*Wenjian Wu,Zesheng Jia,Jiaying Tang,Benyuan Yang,Jin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GeoPAR是一个几何引导的并行自回归强化学习框架，通过投影窗口稀疏几何机制、稀疏边偏置注意力和缓存引导的冲突感知分配三大组件，解决大规模多智能体组合优化问题中并行神经网络求解器性能退化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体组合优化问题具有NP-hard特性，现有并行自回归神经求解器虽提升了推理效率，但在大规模实例上性能下降，主要归因于对局部几何结构建模不足，以及冲突任务选择只在动作生成后才被处理。

Method: 提出GeoPAR框架，包含三个关键组件：(1)投影窗口稀疏几何机制，通过多方向投影构建轻量局部候选邻域；(2)稀疏边偏置注意力，将几何关系注入节点表示；(3)缓存引导的冲突感知分配，在解码阶段复用几何缓存以抑制对独占任务的重复选择。

Result: 在异构车辆路径规划和开放多车场取送货问题上，GeoPAR显著提升了大规模零样本泛化能力，同时大幅减少了rollout步数并保持了高效推理。

Conclusion: GeoPAR通过将几何结构与并行决策过程深度融合，有效缓解了大规模多智能体组合优化中并行神经求解器的性能退化问题，实现了泛化性与推理效率的良好平衡。

Abstract: Multi-agent combinatorial optimization problems are notoriously challenging due to their NP-hard nature. Recent parallel autoregressive neural solvers improve inference efficiency by allowing agents to make decisions simultaneously, but their performance often degrades on large-scale instances. This is largely attributable to weak modeling of local geometric structures and the fact that conflicting task selections are handled only after action generation. To address these limitations, we propose GeoPAR, a geometry-guided parallel autoregressive reinforcement learning framework for scalable multi-agent combinatorial optimization. GeoPAR integrates three key components: (1) a projection-window sparse geometry mechanism that builds lightweight local candidate neighborhoods through multi-directional projections, (2) sparse edge-biased attention that injects these geometric relations into node representations, and (3) cache-guided conflict-aware assignment that reuses the geometric cache during decoding to suppress duplicate selections of exclusive tasks. Experiments on heterogeneous vehicle routing and open multi-depot pickup-and-delivery problems show that GeoPAR improves large-scale zero-shot generalization while substantially reducing rollout steps and maintaining efficient inference.

</details>


### [254] [Foundation models for electricity price forecasting and battery arbitrage: Can they replace market-specific forecasting models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00089)
*Arkadiusz Lipiecki,Rafał Weron*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了五个基础模型家族的九个零样本变体与两个最先进的电价预测基准模型，在德国、波兰和西班牙2021-2025年数据上的表现。结果显示只有TabPFN家族在所有三个市场、所有统计指标上显著优于基准，但这种统计优势并未完全转化为经济优势——TabPFN在无限出价和风险偏好较高的量化策略下表现最佳，而DDNN基准模型在低风险容忍度下更有利可图。结论是基础模型无法普遍替代市场特定的预测模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型声称能以极少或无需任务特定训练就实现准确预测，但它们能否真正取代专门为电价预测设计的模型仍不明确。该研究旨在通过全面实证比较来回答这一关键问题，并进一步考察统计精度优势是否能转化为实际经济价值。

Method: 对来自五个基础模型家族的九个变体进行零样本模式评估，与两个最先进的电价预测基准（包括DDNN等）在三个欧洲市场（德国、波兰、西班牙）2021-2025年期间进行对比。性能评估涵盖点预测精度、概率预测精度以及电池储能套利的经济价值三个维度。

Result: 仅TabPFN模型在所有三个市场及所有统计指标上一致且显著优于基准。然而统计优势并未直接转化为经济优势：TabPFN在无限出价和基于分位数的风险更高策略下表现最佳，而DDNN基准在低风险容忍度条件下利润更高。

Conclusion: 基础模型不能普遍替代市场特定的电价预测模型。其实际价值取决于模型架构（如TabPFN表现突出）以及具体决策问题的风险偏好特性。这提醒我们应谨慎对待基础模型"通用替代"的主张，评估需同时考虑统计指标与经济价值。

Abstract: Foundation models promise accurate forecasts with little or no task-specific training, but whether they can replace models designed specifically for electricity price forecasting remains unclear. We compare nine variants from five foundation model families, evaluated in zero-shot mode, with two state-of-the-art electricity price forecasting benchmarks in Germany, Poland, and Spain over 2021-2025. Their performance is assessed in terms of point and probabilistic forecasting accuracy, as well as economic value in battery energy storage arbitrage. Only the TabPFN models consistently and significantly outperform the benchmarks across all three markets and all statistical measures. However, this statistical dominance does not translate directly into economic dominance: TabPFN performs best under unlimited bids and riskier quantile-based strategies, whereas the Distributional Deep Neural Network benchmark is more profitable when risk tolerance is lower. Thus, foundation models cannot universally replace market-specific models, and their value depends on both model architecture and the decision problem.

</details>


### [255] [Assessing Alignment and Stability of Feature Importance Explanations via Weight of Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00090)
*Eddie Conti,Claudio Daka,Álvaro Parafita,Antonio L. Alfeo,Axel Brando,Mario G. C. A. Cimino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将特征重要性方法（FIMs）嵌入基于证据权重（WoE）的假设检验框架中，以量化观测证据对特征重要性假设的支持程度，从而实现对FIMs的原则性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特征重要性方法（FIMs）虽然广泛用于可解释AI，但归因分数本身往往只能提供有限的内在推理过程洞察，缺乏一种系统性的方法来评估这些归因分数与先验知识或假设之间的一致性。

Method: 将FIMs嵌入基于证据权重（WoE）的假设检验框架中，参考假设可源自领域知识、真实标签或FIM本身，通过量化证据对假设的支持程度来评估FIMs，并提供将WoE与归因方差联系起来的理论结果。

Result: 在LIME和SHAP解释上，针对不同的参考假设设置进行了实证分析，验证了该框架的适用性和灵活性。

Conclusion: 该框架通过对比性、基于证据的视角，为评估FIMs提供了一种互补性工具。

Abstract: Feature importance Methods (FIMs) are widely used in Explainable AI to interpret model predictions, yet attribution scores alone often provide limited insight into the underlying reasoning process. In this work, we introduce a novel perspective by embedding FIMs within a hypothesis-testing framework based on Weight of Evidence (WoE). We quantify how strongly the observed evidence supports any given hypothesis on feature importance. The reference hypothesis can stem from domain knowledge, ground truth, or be derived from the FIM itself. This formulation enables a principled evaluation of FIMs, capturing both their alignment with prior knowledge and their variability. We further provide theoretical results linking WoE to attribution variance. Empirical results shows the applicability and flexibility of our strategy analyzing LIME and SHAP explanations in settings with different reference hypotheses. Overall, our framework offers a complementary tool for assessing FIMs through a contrastive, evidence-based lens.

</details>


### [256] [Safin-1: Safety from Within through Memory-Native State Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00092)
*Ming Zhang,Kaisen Yang,Shu Yu,Ermo Hua,Zhekai Chen,Cheng Jin,Jingnan Zheng,Yi Zhang,Zhongtian Ma,Jiawei Zhou,Sirui Chen,Qiaosheng Zhang,Xiang Wang,Ning Ding,Xia Hu,Bowen Zhou,Youbang Sun,Chaochao Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"内在安全"（Safety from Within）理念，认为安全应是模型自身的固有属性，而非依赖外部护栏或事后对齐。作者介绍了Safin-1模型系列，通过MARCH（Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History）架构实现记忆路由与状态演化，使模型能维护结构化记忆状态并通过内容条件路由选择性检索历史信息，支持测试时对持久能力状态的适应，从而实现"安全状态"（Safety State）驱动的安全性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程复杂任务要求基础模型在长时间交互中积累信息、维持内部状态并持续适应。然而当前的安全保障依赖外部防护或事后对齐（如监督微调），这些方法将安全视为行为约束而非模型内在属性。作者主张安全应当通过模型自身的原生计算来表示和调用，而非外挂式的约束。

Method: 提出Safin-1系列基础模型，核心架构为MARCH（Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History）：该网络架构维护结构化记忆状态，并通过内容条件路由选择性检索相关历史信息。它支持测试时对持久能力状态的适应，无需反复修改骨干网络，即可在共享基础模型上实现受控特化。具体通过"安全状态"（Safety State）接口在下游安全任务上进行状态化适应。

Result: 在安全任务上验证了基于状态适应的有效性，展现了显著的安全性能提升。路由状态接口将上下文记忆与持久能力适应统一在模型原生计算中。此外，在通用能力、长上下文理解、检索和效率等多项评估中验证了Safin-1的性能。

Conclusion: 该工作将记忆从过去上下文的被动记录重新定义为主动维护和演化模型行为的载体，为安全作为状态原生且可自适应维护的能力提供了一条路径。但作者也指出这仅是对"内在安全"愿景的初步架构探索，实现更广泛的愿景仍需大量后续工作。

Abstract: Long-horizon complex tasks require foundation models to accumulate information, maintain internal states, and adapt over extended interactions. Safety should be an intrinsic property of the model itself, rather than a behavioral constraint relying solely on external safeguards or post-hoc alignment such as supervised fine-tuning. This motivates Safety from Within, where safety-relevant capabilities are represented and invoked through the model's native computation. We present Safin-1, a family of foundation models realizing this principle through memory routing and state evolution. Safin-1 is built on Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History (MARCH), a network architecture that maintains structured memory states and selectively retrieves relevant historical information through content-conditioned routing. It supports test-time adaptation of persistent capability states without repeatedly modifying the backbone, enabling controlled specialization over a shared foundation. We investigate this interface on downstream safety tasks through a Safety State, demonstrating effective state-based adaptation with substantial safety improvements. More broadly, the routed-state interface unifies contextual memory and persistent capability adaptation within the model's native computation, reframing memory from a passive record of prior context into an active substrate for maintaining and evolving model behavior. Evaluations across general capabilities, long-context understanding, retrieval, and efficiency further validate Safin-1. These findings provide a path toward safety as a state-native and adaptively maintainable capability. This work is only an initial architectural exploration of Safety from Within, and substantial further work is needed to realize this broader vision.

</details>


### [257] [Local Reference Geometry Residual Augmentation for Imbalanced Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00093)
*Chuanhang Qiu,Yanran Xu,Yue Wang,Anthony Bagnall*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Local Reference Geometry (LRG)，一种轻量级post-hoc特征增强模块，用于诊断和修复不平衡时间序列分类中"训练局部几何失效"问题——即少数类样本在特征空间中处于稀疏、被多数类主导或混合邻域的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不平衡分类方法主要干预训练分布、目标函数、logits或最终阈值，但这些方法忽略了表示层面的问题：当少数类支持被减少时，学习到的特征空间在少数类区域是否仍保持局部可靠？作者识别出训练局部几何失效现象，即少数类样本可能处于稀疏/被多数类主导/混合的特征邻域中，即使全局类结构仍保持有用。

Method: LRG作为固定特征提取器与分类头之间的轻量级post-hoc特征增强模块，仅使用训练特征。它：(1) 度量局部曝光度和类混合风险；(2) 用标准化带符号位移增强每个固定特征（从附近训练几何中提取）；(3) 附加LDA投影的残差摘要。

Result: 在UCR/Bake Off Redux不平衡基准上，raw与LRG的配对比较显示LRG对学习表示、预训练表示和固定表示均有增益，且可与训练级干预和后编码器分类器修正结合。消融实验表明增益来自附加到原始特征的带符号局部残差，而非通用原型距离、亲和特征、标量统计或VLAD风格编码。

Conclusion: 分析支持局部几何失效假设：不平衡下少数类邻域被越来越多地暴露给多数类，训练局部风险能识别易错区域，且LRG的增益集中在高风险区域。

Abstract: Imbalanced time series classification is often addressed by changing the training distribution, objective, logits, or final threshold. These interventions address important biases, yet leave a representation-level question unmeasured: after minority support is reduced, does a learned feature space remain locally reliable around minority regions? We identify a training-local geometry failure: under imbalance, minority cases can lie in sparse, rest-dominated, or mixed feature-space neighborhoods, even when the representation retains useful global class structure. To diagnose and repair this failure, we propose Local Reference Geometry (LRG), a lightweight post-hoc feature augmentation module applied between a fixed feature extractor and the classifier head. Using training features only, LRG measures local exposure and class-mixture risk, then augments each fixed feature with a standardized signed displacement from nearby training geometry and an LDA-projected residual summary. On controlled UCR/Bake Off Redux imbalance benchmarks, paired raw-versus-LRG comparisons show gains for learned, pretrained, and fixed representations, including when LRG is combined with training-level interventions and post-encoder classifier corrections. Ablations show that the gain comes from the signed local residual appended to the original feature, rather than from generic prototype distances, affinity features, scalar statistics, or VLAD-style codes. Further analyses support the proposed local-geometry failure hypothesis: minority neighborhoods become increasingly rest-exposed under imbalance, training-local risk identifies error-prone regions, and LRG gains concentrate in those high-risk regions.

</details>


### [258] [Neural Symbollic Regression Using Deep Learning and Sparse Modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01102)
*Ravi Kumar U,Sumitra S*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个神经符号回归（NSR）框架，采用解耦流水线：神经网络先作为函数预条件器在交互感知的非线性特征空间中学习平滑且抗噪的目标函数近似，再利用LASSO提取稀疏可解释的闭式表达式，并通过Ray Tune和ASHA调度进行分布式超参数优化。在Nguyen基准测试上优于SINDy和未调参的神经基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号回归方法（如遗传编程）面临可扩展性差和对噪声高度敏感的问题；而稀疏回归方法（如SINDy）严重依赖预定义的特征库。需要一种既能处理噪声又能保证可扩展性的符号发现方法。

Method: 提出NSR框架，包含一个解耦的两阶段流水线：(1) 神经网络在交互感知的非线性特征空间中学习目标函数的平滑、抗噪近似；(2) 使用LASSO从学习到的表示中提取稀疏、可解释的闭式表达式。同时集成Ray Tune和ASHA调度的分布式超参数优化来提升预测精度和符号保真度。

Result: 在Nguyen基准测试上，该方法在RMSE、噪声鲁棒性和分布外泛化方面一致优于SINDy和未调参的神经基线。消融研究证实了特征交互、神经深度和调参策略的重要性。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一个可扩展且可理解的神经-符号框架，在神经逼近与稀疏方程发现之间建立了坚实的桥梁，适用于科学机器学习领域。

Abstract: Symbolic Regression (SR) seeks to find succinct mathematical expressions that represent the fundamental relationships within data, providing interpretability and scientific understanding that exceeds that of black-box models. Nevertheless, traditional methods like Genetic Programming face challenges with scalability and are highly sensitive to noise, while sparse regression techniques such as SINDy rely significantly on predetermined feature libraries. In this work, we present a Neural Symbolic Regression (NSR) framework that treats neural networks as functional preconditioners for symbolic discovery. Our approach uses a decoupled pipeline: a neural network first learns a smooth, noise-robust approximation of the target function in an interaction- aware nonlinear feature space. LASSO is then applied to extract sparse, interpretable closed-form expressions. To improve predictive accuracy and symbolic fidelity by integrating distributed hyperparameter optimization with Ray Tune and ASHA scheduling. Experiments on the Nguyen benchmark suite show that our approach consistently outperforms SINDy and non-tuned neural baselines in RMSE, noise robustness, and out-of-distribution generalization. Ablation studies confirm the significance of feature interactions, neural depth, and tuning strategies. In general, this study presents a scalable and understandable neural-symbolic framework, creating a solid link between neural approximation and the discovery of sparse equations for scientific machine learning.

</details>


### [259] [Faster Than Flash: Exploiting Attention Sparsity for Efficient Long-Context Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00097)
*Zhigeng Liu,Zhiyuan Ning,Ruixiao Li,Xiaoran Liu,Yuerong Song,Min Zhang,Ziwei He,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FFD是一个硬件-算法协同设计的框架，通过将选择器和计算器融合进单一内核、采用低比特量化的内容感知扫描和top-delta动态过滤策略，突破长上下文解码中的内存带宽瓶颈，实现高达11.6倍的内核级加速和2.37倍的端到端吞吐量提升，同时支持256K上下文长度并保持模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM解码受限于内存带宽瓶颈和注意力机制的二次复杂度。现有方法中，基于元数据的度量存在内存开销，而自适应选择策略计算效率低，两者之间存在固有权衡，需要新的方案来突破这一限制。

Method: FFD采用三个核心设计：1) 将选择器和计算器融合为全融合内核，用低比特量化的内容感知扫描替代外部元数据索引；2) 提出top-delta策略，无需全局同步即可动态过滤块，实现分布自适应稀疏；3) 支持扫描结果复用进行计算，无需训练且即插即用。

Result: 在内核级别实现最高11.6倍加速，端到端吞吐量提升2.37倍，可扩展到256K上下文长度。在RULER和LongBench基准上的实证验证表明，FFD在保持模型精度的同时实现了高比例的稀疏性。

Conclusion: FFD通过硬件-算法协同设计有效解决了长上下文解码中的内存墙问题，提供了一种无需训练、可插拔的高效解决方案，既能显著加速推理又能保持模型精度，代码已开源。

Abstract: The development of long-context Large Language Models (LLMs) is constrained by the memory bandwidth bottleneck and quadratic complexity of the attention mechanism during decoding. To overcome the inherent trade-offs between the memory overhead of metadata-based metrics and the computational inefficiency of adaptive selection strategies, we present Faster Flash Decoding (FFD), a novel hardware-algorithm co-design framework designed to break the memory wall in long-context decoding. FFD integrates the selector and computer into a fully fused kernel, replacing external metadata indices with content-aware scanning via low-bit quantization. Furthermore, we introduce the top-delta strategy, which dynamically filters blocks to achieve distribution-adaptive sparsity without global synchronization. Offering a training-free and plug-and-play solution, FFD also enables the reuse of scanning results for computation, achieving up to 11.6x kernel-level speedup and scaling to 256K context length, with 2.37x end-to-end throughput improvement. Empirical validation on RULER and LongBench confirms that FFD maintains model accuracy while delivering high-ratio sparsity, with code available at https://github.com/qluoluo/faster-flash-decoding

</details>


### [260] [Rethinking Learnability in Offline Data-driven Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01493)
*Chao Qian,Chen-Guang Wang,Rong-Xi Tan,Ke Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种算法相关的可学习性概念，证明其在离散和连续优化设置中的充分性，并基于此形式化轨迹学习框架，提出UGTL方法，在Design-Bench五个任务上取得最佳平均排名(3.1/25)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线数据驱动优化无需在线评估即可求解高质量解，但此前研究显示PAC可学习性不足以保证离线优化的成功，因为最优点区域即使在大部分区域被学好的情况下仍可能学得不好。因此需要探索何种可学习性足以支撑离线优化。

Method: 1) 提出算法相关的可学习性概念，仅在优化器的轨迹上要求精度；2) 证明其值查询形式对离散设置（如贪婪算法和局部搜索用于子模最大化）是充分的，一阶模拟对凸最小化的投影梯度下降是充分的；3) 形式化轨迹学习框架（轨迹构建、轨迹建模、候选生成）；4) 提出UGTL方法，用条件扩散建模局部一致的改进轨迹并选择多样化候选集。

Result: 在Design-Bench的五个任务上，UGTL在25种方法中取得最佳聚合平均排名(3.1/25)。受控轨迹分析和跨架构替换进一步证实轨迹构建对性能提升起重要作用。

Conclusion: 算法相关的可学习性是离线优化的充分条件，理论证明为轨迹学习方法提供了基础。UGTL通过构造反映合理搜索路径的局部一致改进轨迹，验证了该理论的实用价值，为离线数据驱动优化提供了新的理论和算法方向。

Abstract: Black-Box Optimization (BBO) has found broad applications, but evolutionary algorithms and Bayesian optimization face efficiency challenges as real-world BBO problems grow increasingly complex. Data-driven optimization improves the efficiency of BBO algorithms by learning from data. Offline data-driven optimization seeks high-quality solutions using only a fixed set of previous evaluations, attracting substantial attention because it requires no additional online evaluations. Many offline optimization methods have been proposed, but a fundamental question remains unanswered: what learnability is sufficient for offline optimization? Prior theoretical studies show that Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learnability is insufficient, as the optimal region may remain poorly learned even when most regions are well learned. In this paper, we propose algorithm-dependent learnability, which requires accuracy only on the optimizer's trajectory. We prove that its value-query form is sufficient for representative discrete settings, including greedy and local search for submodular maximization, while its first-order analogue is sufficient for projected gradient descent on convex minimization. Motivated by this notion, we formalize a trajectory-learning framework comprising trajectory construction, trajectory modeling, and candidate generation, and analyze existing trajectory-based methods under it. We further propose Uncertainty-aware Gradient-guided Trajectory Learning (UGTL), which constructs locally coherent improvement trajectories reflecting plausible search paths, models them with conditional diffusion, and selects a diverse candidate set. On five Design-Bench tasks, UGTL achieves the best aggregate mean rank, $3.1/25$, among 25 methods. Controlled trajectory analyses and cross-architecture replacements confirm that our trajectory construction plays a significant role in the improvement.

</details>


### [261] [Generative artificial intelligence for reliable mechanistic reasoning for corrosion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00099)
*Bharath M N,R K Singh Raman,Alankar Alankar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向腐蚀知识合成的领域自适应检索增强生成（RAG）框架，在镁合金腐蚀数据集上微调三种开源语言模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Mistral-7B），并结合混合稠密-词法检索管线。检索增强使Token F1提升143-194%，系统忠实度达0.964、上下文召回率0.988。此外引入Reason Map命题图框架，用于检测因果方向反转与无支撑推理跳跃等扁平事实性指标无法暴露的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腐蚀约占全球GDP的4%，可靠预测对及时缓解至关重要。机器学习虽能有效预测腐蚀速率，但无法解释底层机理。在安全关键的材料工程中，不仅需要准确的检索结果，还需要机制上可辩护的推理能力，而现有事实性指标无法评估这一能力。

Method: 构建领域自适应RAG框架：1）将三种开源语言模型在3,309个来自840篇同行评审论文的专家验证问答对上微调；2）集成混合稠密-词法检索管线进行检索增强；3）提出Reason Map命题图框架，独立构建生成答案与检索文献的有向证据图，检测因果方向反转与无支撑推理跳跃。

Result: 检索增强使Token F1提升143-194%；系统忠实度达0.964，上下文召回率为0.988；在新增文献与内部电化学数据上的盲测外部验证确认了趋势级泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该模块化架构可跨领域应用，为规避腐蚀问题提供了可信赖AI辅助知识合成的通用蓝图，也可推广至其他工程领域。

Abstract: Corrosion accounts for approximately 4% of global GDP, and reliable prediction is essential for timely mitigation. Machine learning effectively predicts corrosion rates from composition, microstructure, and environmental variables, but cannot explain the underlying mechanisms. A reliable approach in safety-critical materials engineering requires not only accurate retrieval but also mechanistically defensible reasoning, a capability that existing factuality metrics cannot assess. This work presents a domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation framework for corrosion knowledge synthesis, demonstrated on magnesium alloy corrosion. Three open-weight language models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) are fine-tuned on 3,309 expert-verified question-answer pairs from 840 peer-reviewed papers and integrated with a hybrid dense-lexical retrieval pipeline. Retrieval augmentation produces Token F1 gains of 143-194%, with system faithfulness of 0.964 and context recall of 0.988. Blind external validation on newly published literature and in-house electrochemical data confirms trend-level generalisation. Reason Map, a proposition-graph framework, is further introduced; it independently constructs directed evidence graphs from generated answers and retrieved literature, enabling systematic detection of causal direction inversions and unsupported inferential leaps that flat factuality metrics cannot expose. The modular architecture can be applied across domains, offering a generalizable blueprint for trustworthy AI-assisted knowledge synthesis to circumvent corrosion, which can also be applied to other engineering domains.

</details>


### [262] [Good Memory Has ECC: Evaluating the Memory of Vision-Language Models Beyond Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00103)
*Shmuel Berman,Jia Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ECCBench基准与评估协议，从效率（Efficiency）、压缩（Compression）、校准（Calibration）三个维度衡量记忆系统在容量之外的性能。研究发现预训练VLM在文本上能压缩记忆但在视频上不能，且两者校准均较差；部分非Transformer架构在压缩-校准权衡上优于RoPE Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆基准仅通过长文本或视频上的准确率评估LLM/VLM的"记忆能力"，但纯准确率忽略了长时程任务中真正重要的属性（如计算开销、压缩能力、不确定性校准），无法全面反映记忆系统的实际可用性。

Method: 提出ECCBench基准与评估协议，通过三条轴衡量记忆能力：效率（回答问题所需的FLOPs计算量）、压缩（可压缩输入是否能被更准确或更高效地记住）、校准（系统是否根据自身不确定性进行弃权，以及错误成本）。综合评估多种预训练VLM和记忆骨干架构。

Result: 预训练VLM在文本输入上能够压缩记忆，但在视频输入上不能；且无论文本或视频，其不确定性校准均表现较差。在更广泛的记忆骨干架构比较中，多种非Transformer架构在压缩-校准权衡上优于RoPE Transformer。

Conclusion: 记忆评估不应局限于原始准确率，ECCBench的三轴框架（效率、压缩、校准）能更全面地刻画记忆系统的实用性；非Transformer架构在压缩-校准权衡上的优势暗示其可能更适用于长时程智能体任务，值得进一步探索。

Abstract: Memory is widely viewed as an important unsolved problem for LLMs and VLMs, and current benchmarks typically evaluate it by testing accuracy over long text or video. However, accuracy alone misses properties that matter for real long-horizon tasks. We introduce ECCBench, a benchmark and evaluation protocol that measures memory beyond a system's capacity--its raw accuracy at a specific budget--via three axes we call ECC: efficiency--the computation, in FLOPs, needed to answer from memory; compression--whether compressible inputs are remembered more accurately or efficiently; and calibration--whether the system abstains in response to its own uncertainty and the cost of an error. We find that pretrained VLMs compress their memory over text but not video and are poorly calibrated on both. Among a broader set of memory backbones, several non-Transformer architectures achieve better compression-calibration tradeoffs than RoPE Transformers, suggesting they may be useful components for agents operating over long horizons.

</details>


### [263] [Elite-Weighted Supervised Fine-tuning for Goal-Directed Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00189)
*Shiyun Wa,Yifei Wang,Anna G. Green,Simone Sciabola,Ye Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Elite-Weighted Supervised Fine-tuning (EW-SFT)，一种统一的目标导向分子优化方法。它通过奖励指导精英样本筛选，并用模型自身的预训练损失更新模型，无需轨迹级策略梯度，可跨多种生成架构（自回归、掩码扩散、离散流）和生成任务（从头设计、基序延伸、链接设计）复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的目标导向分子优化多采用策略梯度强化学习，其需要与模型架构和生成过程耦合的轨迹对数概率形式，导致优化器难以在不同架构和条件生成设计间复用。监督微调虽然架构无关，但更新由固定数据集驱动，奖励无法进入更新过程。因此需要一种既架构无关又能引入奖励的统一优化方法。

Method: EW-SFT利用奖励指导高分分子（精英样本）的筛选，仅以选中的精英集合通过模型自身预训练损失进行微调更新。消融实验表明奖励信息主要通过精英筛选传递，而非集合内的连续加权。由于更新仅依赖评分分子和模型的原生损失，同一规则可适用于自回归、掩码扩散和离散流生成器，以及多种生成约束任务。

Result: 在固定3D形状对齐oracle调用预算下（两个激酶参考化合物），EW-SFT持续优于相应的原生优化器。在4个留存参考化合物的2D相似度oracle下进一步改进目标导向优化，在无需轨迹级RL的样本效率基准上取得可比性能。

Conclusion: EW-SFT是一种统一且有效的优化器，可跨分子生成器、设计约束、参考化合物和oracle类型广泛适用，兼具架构无关性与奖励引导能力。

Abstract: Goal-directed optimization is essential for steering molecular generators to propose candidates with desired properties. However, it is often implemented with policy-gradient reinforcement learning, which requires a generation-trajectory log-probability whose form depends on the model architecture and generation procedure. This makes an optimizer difficult to reuse across architectures and conditional generative designs. Supervised fine-tuning needs none of that machinery, but its update is driven by a fixed dataset, so the reward never enters the update. We introduce Elite-Weighted Supervised Fine-tuning (EW-SFT), which uses reward to guide elite selection of high-scoring molecules, and updates the model by its own pretraining loss on that set. Ablations show that reward information is passed primarily through elite selection, rather than through continuous weighting within the selected set. Because the update consumes only scored molecules and the model's native loss, the same rule applies across autoregressive, masked-diffusion, and discrete-flow generators, and across de novo, motif-extension, and linker-design tasks. Under a fixed budget of 3D shape alignment oracle calls on two kinase reference compounds, EW-SFT consistently outperforms the corresponding native optimizers. It further improves goal-directed optimization under a 2D similarity oracle on four held-out references and achieves comparable performance on a sample-efficiency benchmark without a trajectory-level RL formulation. These results demonstrate that EW-SFT is a unified and effective optimizer across molecular generators, design constraints, references, and oracles.

</details>


### [264] [Retrieved but not ranked: surface-form bias in structural retrieval, from mathematics to agent trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01556)
*Nabira Rashid,Manolis Kellis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了嵌入检索在"表面形式与意义刻意分离"场景下的表现，覆盖数学竞赛题（MathNet-Retrieve）和具身智能体轨迹（ALFWorld衍生）两个无关领域。结果显示生产级嵌入器在数学最重伪装层级上严格Hit@1为0.0%，在轨迹任务中接近或低于超几何随机水平，说明检索锚定在字面token而非任务结构上。词法重排器控制组的符号揭示了表面变化是对抗性还是偶然性；LLM重排器虽能恢复部分差距，但部分收益源于记忆化。下游实验表明oracle检索与对抗性差检索无法区分，求解器零样本准确率主要是截断代理，无提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有嵌入检索评测大多假设查询与目标之间存在表面相似性，但现实任务中常需要检索"结构相同但表述不同"的项。作者希望专门构造表面形式与意义被刻意拉开的评测基准，检验嵌入模型是否真正理解深层结构而非字面匹配，并探究词法与LLM重排器在不同表面变化类型下的恢复能力。

Method: 设计两个领域的统一评测协议：数学竞赛题（500查询，117,088条语料，含伪装层级）和具身体轨迹（118查询，336条轨迹）。使用两个生产级嵌入器，比较词法重排器与LLM重排器的恢复效果（三个评判器），并在下游求解实验中（210查询，graders 96-99%一致性对比oracle与bad检索）验证检索对最终任务的影响。

Result: 数学领域伪装最重层上两个嵌入器Hit@1=0.0%（CI [0,0]），但正确项几乎总在前10；95.2-99.8%的失败情况中赢家比正确答案词法更相似。轨迹领域当gold需涉及不同对象时模型接近超几何随机水平，若对象和容器都需不同则低于随机。词法重排器在数学中起反作用、在轨迹中有帮助（缩小26-36%差距）。LLM重排器在数学恢复5-63%、轨迹恢复43-76%的差距，但数学收益集中在知名竞赛题目上（+19.8分），表明部分恢复是记忆化。下游实验中oracle与bad检索无显著差异（McNemar p=0.678）。

Conclusion: 当前生产级嵌入器在结构检索上严重依赖字面token相似度，无法处理对抗性的表面形式变化。词法重排器的符号方向可作为判断基准表面变化性质（对抗性vs偶然性）的诊断工具。LLM重排器的恢复效果部分来自训练数据记忆而非真正的结构理解。最关键的发现是：在该求解器设置下，即使完美的oracle检索也无法提供下游任务提升空间，因为在已生成答案上的截断机制已覆盖了97-100%的准确率，检索质量并非当前瓶颈。

Abstract: We evaluate embedding retrieval where surface form and meaning are pulled apart on purpose: retrieving items that share underlying structure but not wording, in two unrelated domains under one protocol, competition mathematics (MathNet-Retrieve; 500 queries, 117,088-item corpus) and embodied-agent trajectories (ALFWorld-derived; 118 queries, 336 trajectories). In mathematics the failure is complete: strict Hit@1 at the heaviest disguise tier is 0.0% for both production embedders (bootstrap 95% CI [0.0, 0.0]) while the correct item sits in the top 10 nearly always, and in 95.2 to 99.8% of misses the winner is more lexically similar to the query than the correct answer. In trajectories, where surface variation is incidental, the same models land at or near hypergeometric chance when gold must involve a different object, and below chance for all three embedders once gold must differ in object and receptacle: retrieval anchors on literal tokens, not task structure. A lexical reranker control hurts in mathematics and helps in trajectories (closing 26 to 36% of the gap, CIs excluding zero); its sign reveals whether a benchmark's surface variation is adversarial or incidental. An LLM reranker recovers 5 to 63% of the gap in mathematics and 43 to 76% in trajectories; direction replicates across three judges (all 21 cells positive), but effect sizes, tier profiles, and the outlier judge change with domain (paired differences excluding zero everywhere). Mathematics gains concentrate on well-known competitions (+19.8 points, CI [+6.7, +33.2], one of six cells), so part of the recovery is memorization.
